column3: Oppsving

column2: Kidnap
column3: Bortfoering

column2:
{%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02},

You must help me! My only daughter was kidnapped by pirates 5 days ago. The pirate was {%N:06}, who seems an insidious specimen, who somehow managed to board our ship. Please help me while there is still hope for my daughter.
Give me your decision within 10 days.

{%R:04} {%v:04} {%n:04}
column3:
{%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02},

De maa hjelpe meg! Min eneste datter ble bortfoert av pirater for 5 dager siden. Piraten var {%N:06}, en lumsk type som paa et vis klarte aa entre skipet vaart. Hjelp meg, ber jeg, mens det ennaa er haap for datteren min.
Gi meg Deres beslutning innen 10 dager.

{%R:04} {%v:04} {%n:04}

column2:
Dear {%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02},

Thank you for agreeing to help me. The pirate was last seen 1 day's journey north of Edinburgh. If I were you, that would be the first place I'd look for him. But take care! You must not sink his ship; you must board it! He has a cog with at least 30 men who are armed to the teeth!
If my daughter isn't back here with me in {%t:03} in 30 days, I will assume that you have failed.

{%R:04} {%v:04} {%n:04}
column3:
Kjaere {%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02},

Takk for at De har sagt ja til aa hjelpe meg. Piraten ble sist sett 1 dagsreise nord for Edinburgh. Var jeg Dem, ville jeg lett etter ham der foerst. Men vaer forsiktig! De maa ikke senke skipet hans, De maa entre det! Han har en kogge med minst 30 mann, vaepnet til tennene!
Er ikke datteren min tilbake hos meg i {%t:03} innen 30 dager, gaar jeg ut fra at De har mislyktes.

{%R:04} {%v:04} {%n:04}

column2:
Dear {%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02},

I am so overjoyed at my daughter's safe return. Although I can barely express my gratitude with a reward, I hope you will accept these 30,000\C.
But there is something else that would give me even greater pleasure. Would you care to take my daughter to be your wife?

{%R:04} {%v:04} {%n:04}
column3:
Kjaere {%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02},

Jeg er saa lykkelig over at datteren min er kommet trygt hjem. Selv om en beloenning knapt kan uttrykke min takknemlighet, haaper jeg De vil ta imot disse 30 000\C.
Men det er noe som ville glede meg enda mer. Vil De ta min datter til hustru?

{%R:04} {%v:04} {%n:04}

column2: Disaster
column3: Katastrofe

column2: \nThere are now {%B:07} people living in the Hanseatic League region. That means that through your deeds the Hanseatic League has increased by 30,000 inhabitants. Ensure it increases to 90,000 inhabitants by {%D:00} to complete your mission on time.
column3: \nNaa bor det {%B:07} mennesker i Hansaens omraade. Gjennom Deres gjerninger har Hansaen altsaa vokst med 30 000 innbyggere. Soerg for at den vokser til 90 000 innbyggere innen {%D:00} for aa fullfoere oppdraget Deres i tide.

column2: Fire
column3: Brann

column2: Plague
column3: Pest

column2: \nThe Hanseatic League has now grown by 20,000 inhabitants, which means that there are now {%B:07} citizens in the Hanseatic League. Increase this number to 90,000 by {%D:00}.
column3: \nHansaen har naa vokst med 20 000 innbyggere, noe som betyr at det naa er {%B:07} borgere i Hansaen. Oek dette tallet til 90 000 innen {%D:00}.

column2:
Thanks to your efforts, the Hanseatic League has already grown by 10,000 inhabitants. Keep it up! There are now {%B:07} citizens living in the Hanseatic League region.
You still have until {%D:00} to achieve a population of 90,000.
column3:
Takket vaere Deres innsats har Hansaen allerede vokst med 10 000 innbyggere. Fortsett slik! Naa bor det {%B:07} borgere i Hansaens omraade.
De har fortsatt til {%D:00} paa aa naa en befolkning paa 90 000.

column2: \nAs the Hanseatic League has been growing perceptibly again for some time, even the top traders are starting to return. Although there aren't many at the moment, more and more ships will converge on the harbours from now on, to distribute their manufactured goods.
column3: \nSiden Hansaen en tid naa igjen har vokst merkbart, begynner til og med de store handelsmennene aa vende tilbake. Selv om de ennaa ikke er mange, vil stadig flere skip fra naa av soeke til havnene for aa spre sine bearbeidede varer.

column2: Please accept our thanks!
column3: Ta imot vaar takk!

column2: Campaign failed
column3: Kampanjen mislyktes

column2: \nUnfortunately you have not managed to settle the required number of citizens in the Hanseatic League region. The Hanseatic League region currently has a population of {%B:07}, but your goal was 90,000. Still, you can always try again.
column3: \nDessverre har De ikke klart aa bosette det noedvendige antall borgere i Hansaens omraade. Omraadet har for tiden {%B:07} innbyggere, men maalet Deres var 90 000. De kan alltid proeve igjen.

column2: London thanks you
column3: London takker Dem

column2: Pirates outside Stettin
column3: Pirater utenfor Stettin

column2:
Dear {%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02},

Now, after all the disasters of the past few weeks, Stettin is in great danger. A pirate called {%N:04} is threatening all traders who try to put in at Stettin. Soon there won't be any traders that dare to supply Stettin with the goods that we need so badly.
I have heard much of your deeds, so I now wish to ask how much you would charge to save us from this life-threatening situation?
Our ships are too weak for us to be able to catch the pirate. If you help us, you will be richly rewarded. If you don't, the pirate will lurk outside our beloved town forever.

Mayor of Stettin{%+:03}
column3:
Kjaere {%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02},

Naa, etter alle ulykkene de siste ukene, er Stettin i stor fare. En pirat ved navn {%N:04} truer alle handelsmenn som proever aa anloepe Stettin. Snart vil ingen handelsmann vaage aa forsyne Stettin med de varene vi saa saart trenger.
Jeg har hoert mye om Deres gjerninger, saa jeg vil gjerne spoerre hva De ville ta for aa redde oss ut av denne livsfarlige situasjonen.
Skipene vaare er for svake til aa fange piraten. Hjelper De oss, blir De rikelig beloennet. Gjoer De det ikke, vil piraten lure utenfor vaar elskede by for alltid.

Borgermesteren i Stettin{%+:03}

column2: Pirate destroyed
column3: Pirat tilintetgjort

column2: Pirate missing
column3: Pirat forsvunnet

column2: Evil deeds
column3: Onde gjerninger

column2: Sabotage
column3: Sabotasje

column2:
Dear {%R:00} {%v:00} {%n:00},

We now know who sent Rostock's saboteurs: they are from Bruges! We should teach that town a lesson it won't forget. Put together a strong fleet and attack Bruges harbour! That is the only way to make the Rostock saboteurs withdraw.
To help you, the {%R:0C} {%v:0C} {%n:0C} from Luebeck has provided a heavily armed cog. It is in Luebeck harbour, and you can collect it whenever you like.
And one more thing: to avoid unnecessary trouble, you should disguise yourself as a pirate before you attack Bruges.

The Hanseatic League council{%+:01}
column3:
Kjaere {%R:00} {%v:00} {%n:00},

Naa vet vi hvem som sendte sabotoerene i Rostock: de kommer fra Bruges! Vi burde gi den byen en lekse den ikke glemmer. Sett sammen en sterk flaate og angrip havnen i Bruges! Bare slik faar vi sabotoerene i Rostock til aa trekke seg tilbake.
For aa hjelpe Dem har {%R:0C} {%v:0C} {%n:0C} fra Luebeck stilt en tungt bevaepnet kogge til disposisjon. Den ligger i havnen i Luebeck, og De kan hente den naar De vil.
Og én ting til: for aa unngaa unoedig bry boer De forkle Dem som pirat foer De angriper Bruges.

Hansaens raad{%+:01}

column2: Saboteurs
column3: Sabotoerer

column2: \nThe cowardly {%N:0A} has set out in his last few ships to sabotage the Hanseatic League, even if it kills him. You should find him as quickly as possible and finally free the Hanseatic League from his wicked deeds. He was last seen near {%t:09}.
column3: \nDen feige {%N:0A} har stukket til sjoes med sine siste skip for aa sabotere Hansaen, om det saa koster ham livet. De boer finne ham saa fort som mulig og endelig befri Hansaen fra hans onde gjerninger. Han ble sist sett naer {%t:09}.

column2: \nThe terrible pirate, {%N:0A}, was last sighted near {%t:09}!
column3: \nDen fryktede piraten {%N:0A} ble sist sett naer {%t:09}!

column2: Thank Goodness
column3: Gudskjelov

column2:
You still have trading offices in the towns of Stettin and Stockholm, although the towns are in a sorry state. You should start by building these towns, as well as Rostock, up again by supplying them with goods. You can manufacture the most important goods yourself as soon as workers start arriving in your towns again.
You should only worry about the other Hansa towns when these towns' populations have been stabilised.
column3:
De har fortsatt kontorer i byene Stettin og Stockholm, selv om byene er i en soergelig forfatning. De boer begynne med aa bygge opp disse byene, og ogsaa Rostock, igjen ved aa forsyne dem med varer. De viktigste varene kan De produsere selv saa snart arbeidere igjen begynner aa komme til byene Deres.
Tenk foerst paa de andre hansabyene naar befolkningen i disse byene er stabilisert.

column2:
You will have noticed that there are hardly any traders. A lot of ships have been sunk by pirates, although many others returned home when their voyages ceased to be profitable.
Don't worry - the traders will come back in due course.
Once your 3 towns are flourishing, more and more traders will start turning up again, helping you to rebuild the Hanseatic League.
column3:
De har sikkert merket at det knapt finnes handelsmenn. Mange skip er senket av pirater, og mange andre vendte hjem da reisene deres sluttet aa loenne seg.
Vaer ikke bekymret: handelsmennene kommer tilbake med tiden.
Saa snart Deres 3 byer blomstrer, vil stadig flere handelsmenn dukke opp igjen og hjelpe Dem med aa bygge opp Hansaen.

column2:
Welcome, {%R:00} {%n:00}.

We sent a petition to all the remaining trustworthy Hanseatic League traders. When they heard that you were willing to help us to achieve our former glory, they gave what they could spare. Take this 200,000\C as a gift. Or better still: pay it back in the form of flourishing towns.
Once the traders see that you can be trusted, they are certain to put even more funds at your disposal.

Your Alderman {%F:00}{%+:01}
column3:
Velkommen, {%R:00} {%n:00}.

Vi sendte en oppfordring til alle gjenvaerende paalitelige hansahandlere. Da de hoerte at De var villig til aa hjelpe oss aa gjenvinne vaar tidligere storhet, gav de det de kunne unnvaere. Ta imot disse 200 000\C som en gave. Eller enda bedre: betal dem tilbake i form av blomstrende byer.
Saa snart handelsmennene ser at De er til aa stole paa, vil de sikkert stille enda mer midler til Deres disposisjon.

Deres olderman {%F:00}{%+:01}

column2: \nAs you can see, a lot of facilities in the towns are standing empty. In places where you have trading offices, you should try to buy as many facilities as possible. But take care: don't buy more than you will be able to maintain later on. Because if there is no great demand in the towns, you will hardly have any income.
column3: \nSom De ser, staar mange virksomheter i byene tomme. Der De har kontorer, boer De proeve aa kjoepe saa mange virksomheter som mulig. Men vaer forsiktig: kjoep ikke flere enn De senere kan holde ved like. For er det ingen stor etterspoersel i byene, faar De knapt noen inntekter.

column2:
Grain is being considerably over-produced in Gdansk. You should buy it and fill your warehouses with it. It is sure to come in useful.
Bergen has lots of ore, Luebeck iron goods, London wool and Novgorod furs. Malmö has a lot of meat.
Buy as many of these goods as you can. They will be very useful when you are building up the Hanseatic League.
But bear in mind that you will hardly be able to sell any of these goods at present. They will only be of use to you in the future.
column3:
I Gdansk produseres det altfor mye korn. Kjoep det og fyll lagrene Deres med det. Det kommer sikkert til nytte.
Bergen har mye malm, Luebeck jernvarer, London ull og Novgorod pelsverk. Malmö har mye kjoett.
Kjoep saa mye av disse varene som De kan. De blir svaert nyttige naar De bygger opp Hansaen.
Men husk at De for tiden knapt kan selge noe av dem. De vil foerst vaere til nytte for Dem i fremtiden.

column2:
{%7:03},

The legend of the Kobold is circulating amongst the crew again. I have heard of instances where the crew have got so worked up that they have put the whole ship in danger.
I shall be harder on the sailors than usual, so that they can get this dangerous superstition out of their heads as quickly as possible.

Helmsman of the {%s:04}
column3:
{%7:03},

Sagnet om skipsnissen gaar igjen rundt blant mannskapet. Jeg har hoert om tilfeller der mannskaper ble saa oppjaget at de satte hele skipet i fare.
Jeg skal vaere strengere mot sjoemennene enn vanlig, saa de fortest mulig faar denne farlige overtroen ut av hodet.

Styrmannen paa {%s:04}

column2:
{%7:03},

Once again, those gullible poltroons have picked up something about the Kobold. It is this very spirit that protects every ship, and if he should ever disembark, the ship would be lost, including its crew and cargo. You will have heard the legend that the Kobold is supposed to show himself just before he leaves the ship. But now these tars reckon they're seeing the Kobold leering out at them from behind every plank.
Morale is not at its highest, so it might be better if you took care of it yourself!

Helmsman of the {%s:04}
column3:
{%7:03},

Nok en gang har disse godtroende kujonene snappet opp noe om skipsnissen. Det er nettopp denne aanden som beskytter hvert skip, og om han noen gang gaar i land, er skipet tapt, med mannskap og last. De har vel hoert sagnet om at skipsnissen skal vise seg like foer han forlater skipet. Men naa mener disse sjoeulkene aa se nissen glise mot dem bak hver planke.
Moralen er ikke paa topp, saa det var kanskje bedre om De tok Dem av det selv!

Styrmannen paa {%s:04}

column2:
{%7:03},

One of the older sailors told the younger ones that the Kobold leaves any ship whose owner acts in a way that is displeasing to God.
I have managed to calm the crew down by telling them that you were renowned for your honesty throughout the entire Hanseatic League. Now everybody on board is concentrating on their duties again.

Helmsman of the {%s:04}
column3:
{%7:03},

En av de eldre sjoemennene fortalte de yngre at skipsnissen forlater ethvert skip der eieren handler paa en maate som mishager Gud.
Jeg har faatt roet mannskapet ved aa si at De er kjent i hele Hansaen for Deres aerlighet. Naa konsentrerer alle om bord seg igjen om pliktene sine.

Styrmannen paa {%s:04}

column2:
{%7:03},

This time, even members of our own crew say they have seen the ghost ship. And now that the crew has heard talk in the {%t:07} taverns about a ship that is long overdue, there are rumours going round that it has been captured by the 'Flying Trader'.
You will not be surprised to learn that all this unfortunate speculation has damaged the crew's morale.

Helmsman of the {%s:04}
column3:
{%7:03},

Denne gangen sier til og med folk fra vaart eget mannskap at de har sett spoekelsesskipet. Og naa som mannskapet har hoert snakk i kneipene i {%t:07} om et skip som lenge har vaert forsinket, gaar det rykter om at det er kapret av "Den flygende kjoepmannen".
Det vil ikke overraske Dem at all denne uheldige spekulasjonen har skadet mannskapets moral.

Styrmannen paa {%s:04}

column2: Competitor
column3: Konkurrent

column2: \\\\f1_Greetings! I see you are a fine sailor who is neither afraid of death nor the Devil. I have an order that may be of interest to you, as it can make you rich. The business of an extremely upright trader from {%t:00} is being threatened so much by a competitor that he fears for his very livelihood. It appears that his rival is willing to use any possible means to bring him to financial ruin. Our friend therefore needs the help of a bold sailor who can use cannons and gunpowder to stop his adversary in his tracks. Are you in?|\\\\f1_Wonderful. But I don't want to give you any further instructions out here in public, so I'll send you more information forthwith, in a letter.
column3: \\\\f1_Vaer hilset! Jeg ser at De er en dyktig sjoemann som verken frykter doeden eller djevelen. Jeg har et oppdrag som kan interessere Dem, for det kan gjoere Dem rik. En svaert hederlig handelsmann fra {%t:00} trues saa hardt av en konkurrent at han frykter for selve levebroedet sitt. Det ser ut til at rivalen er villig til aa bruke ethvert middel for aa ruinere ham. Vaar venn trenger derfor hjelp fra en dristig sjoemann som med kanoner og krutt kan stanse motstanderen hans. Er De med?|\\\\f1_Herlig. Men jeg vil ikke gi Dem flere instrukser her ute blant folk, saa jeg sender Dem mer informasjon straks, i et brev.

column2: Competitors
column3: Konkurrenter

column2:
Marvellous!

That will please my client. You will receive {%c:01} from me as soon as {%R:08} {%V:0B} {%N:09} has one less ship in his fleet. But there's one thing you should know: don't get caught!
I'll contact you in 2 weeks - until then, best of luck.
column3:
Storartet!

Det vil glede oppdragsgiveren min. De faar {%c:01} av meg saa snart {%R:08} {%V:0B} {%N:09} har ett skip mindre i flaaten sin. Men én ting skal De vite: la Dem ikke ta!
Jeg kontakter Dem om 2 uker; inntil da, lykke til.

column2: Stop right there!
column3: Stopp der!

column2:
Stop right there!

I happen to have learned that {%R:07} {%V:0B} {%N:09} wishes misfortune on me, and that you're supposed to be causing it! And just because he wants the businesses in {%t:00} all for himself!
But what I say is: first come, first served. Don't you agree? If you do, then we should turn the tables on him! Sink one of {%R:07} {%N:09}'s ships and I'll give you double what he's offered you!
column3:
Stopp der!

Jeg har tilfeldigvis faatt vite at {%R:07} {%V:0B} {%N:09} oensker meg ulykke, og at det er De som skal foraarsake den! Og bare fordi han vil ha forretningene i {%t:00} helt for seg selv!
Men jeg sier: foerst til moella. Er De ikke enig? I saa fall snur vi steken! Senk et av {%R:07} {%N:09}s skip, saa gir jeg Dem det dobbelte av hva han har tilbudt!

column2: Revenge is sweet
column3: Hevnen er soet

column2:
Good work!

Let that be a lesson to that treacherous {%N:09}! Here is a bag containing {%c:01}, as promised.
It's good to know that there are still some traders on the side of justice.
column3:
Godt arbeid!

La det vaere en lekse for den forraederske {%N:09}! Her er en pung med {%c:01}, som lovet.
Det er godt aa vite at det fortsatt finnes handelsmenn paa rettferdighetens side.

column2: Lesson
column3: Lekse

column2:
Ha, ha!

That'll teach {%N:09} to make himself at home in my business. Here are the {%c:01} as promised.
I may be in touch if I need your help again.
column3:
Ha, ha!

Det skal laere {%N:09} aa ikke gjoere seg hjemmekjent i forretningene mine. Her er de lovede {%c:01}.
Kanskje tar jeg kontakt igjen hvis jeg trenger Deres hjelp.

column2: Peace
column3: Fred

column2: Message
column3: Beskjed

column2:
{%1:01}{%V:09},

Gshhe thing is, we've been shampling shome of your delicious, hic, {%W:05} on board. We're afraid we're, hick schcuse me, not very seaworthy now, hic, but we sshould be all right in a day or two.

Lotsh of love,
Your faithful crew of the {%s:07}, hic
column3:
{%1:01}{%V:09},

Shaken er den at vi har shmakt litt paa Deres deilige, hikk, {%W:05} om bord. Vi er redde for at vi, hikk, unnshkyld, ikke er saa sjoedyktige akkurat naa, hikk, men om en dag eller to burde det gaa bra igjen.

Mange klemmer,
Deres trofaste mannskap paa {%s:07}, hikk

column2: Damage
column3: Skade

column2: Pirate hunter
column3: Piratjeger

column2:
\\f1_Greetings,
My name is {%V:08} {%N:07}. Might you be interested in doing me a huge favour, for which I will reward you handsomely? You see, there's a certain vicious pirate to whom I once lost my most magnificent ship. After many months, I finally managed to pick up his scent. I planted a spy with him, who recently reported back to me. So now I know the pirate's secret whereabouts.
Would you be willing to visit his hiding place and get rid of him once and for all? If you could do that, it would be worth {%c:05} to me.|\\f1_Thank you. Maybe I'll be able to sleep at night if the pirate is destroyed. I'll have a map showing his whereabouts delivered to you forthwith.
column3:
\\f1_Vaer hilset,
Mitt navn er {%V:08} {%N:07}. Kunne De tenke Dem aa gjoere meg en stor tjeneste, som jeg vil beloenne Dem rikelig for? Ser De, det finnes en viss ondskapsfull pirat som jeg en gang mistet mitt prektigste skip til. Etter mange maaneder har jeg endelig faatt teften av ham. Jeg plasserte en spion hos ham, som nylig rapporterte til meg. Saa naa kjenner jeg piratens hemmelige gjemmested.
Vil De oppsoeke gjemmestedet hans og bli kvitt ham en gang for alle? Kunne De gjoere det, ville det vaere verdt {%c:05} for meg.|\\f1_Takk. Kanskje kan jeg sove om natten hvis piraten blir tilintetgjort. Jeg lar straks et kart over gjemmestedet hans bli brakt til Dem.

column2: \\\\f1_Please help me to wreak revenge on a pirate! My name is {%V:08} {%N:07} and my brother was killed recently in a sea battle with a pirate. Now I have sold all of our possessions to raise enough money for a courageous seafarer who can wipe this pirate off the face of the earth. Will you help me to avenge my brother for {%c:05}?|\\\\f1_Justice will at last be done. Take this map and find the pirate, may he never be permitted to do any more wrong in this world.\n
column3: \\\\f1_Hjelp meg aa hevne meg paa en pirat! Mitt navn er {%V:08} {%N:07}, og broren min ble nylig drept i et sjoeslag mot en pirat. Naa har jeg solgt alt vi eide for aa skaffe nok penger til en modig sjoefarer som kan utslette denne piraten fra jordens overflate. Vil De hjelpe meg aa hevne broren min for {%c:05}?|\\\\f1_Endelig skal rettferdigheten skje fyllest. Ta dette kartet og finn piraten; maatte han aldri mer faa gjoere urett i denne verden.\n

column2:
{%5:01}{%N:0D},

You have fulfilled my wishes, so I shall pay you the agreed reward of {%c:05}.
Once again, thank you!

{%V:08} {%N:07}
column3:
{%5:01}{%N:0D},

De har oppfylt mine oensker, saa jeg betaler Dem den avtalte beloenningen paa {%c:05}.
Nok en gang, takk!

{%V:08} {%N:07}

column2: Pirate escaped
column3: Pirat roemt

column2:
Curses!

I have been told that the pirate heard about our plan and found himself a new hiding place! So he has escaped because you were too slow!
So you won't be surprised if I withdraw the reward I offered you!

{%V:08} {%N:07}
column3:
Pokker!

Jeg har faatt hoere at piraten fikk nyss om planen vaar og fant seg et nytt gjemmested! Han har altsaa sluppet unna fordi De var for treg!
Saa det vil ikke overraske Dem at jeg trekker tilbake beloenningen jeg tilboed Dem!

{%V:08} {%N:07}

column2: Siege
column3: Beleiring

column2: Courier
column3: Kurer

column2: \\\\f1_You have been recommended to me - I have heard that you are fast and reliable. I have a small problem and I would like to beg humbly for your services. I have some urgent courier work that needs to taken care of and unfortunately the captain, who gave me his word, has broken his promise and hasn't appeared.  A number of vitally important packages and documents need to be delivered to various towns. The faster you are, the more handsomely I shall pay you. If you have a ship in {%t:00} with at least 3 \\L of free storage space, we can get started.
column3: \\\\f1_De er blitt anbefalt meg; jeg har hoert at De er rask og paalitelig. Jeg har et lite problem og vil ydmykt be om Deres tjenester. Jeg har et hastende kureroppdrag, og dessverre har kapteinen som ga meg sitt ord, brutt loeftet sitt og ikke dukket opp. En rekke livsviktige pakker og dokumenter maa leveres i ulike byer. Jo raskere De er, desto rausere betaler jeg Dem. Har De et skip i {%t:00} med minst 3 \\L ledig lasterom, kan vi sette i gang.

column2: Take cargo
column3: Ta last

column2: \nUnfortunately I was unable to find a ship in {%t:00} that would have 3 \\L of free space.
column3: \nDessverre fant jeg ikke noe skip i {%t:00} med 3 \\L ledig plass.

column2: Let's go
column3: Av sted

column2:
Come on,

The cargo is on board and the sails are awaiting good winds.
The first place I need to be is {%t:00}. Please take me there as fast as the currents of fate will allow.
I shall be meeting a trader when we arrive in {%t:00}. In the meantime, drop anchor in the harbour until I tell you the next destination on our voyage.
Don't forget: the faster I travel, the higher my payment will be - and your share too.

Courier on board the {%s:05}
column3:
Kom igjen,

Lasten er om bord og seilene venter paa god vind.
Det foerste stedet jeg maa til, er {%t:00}. Foer meg dit saa raskt som skjebnens stroemmer tillater.
Jeg skal moete en handelsmann naar vi kommer til {%t:00}. I mellomtiden ankrer De i havnen til jeg forteller Dem neste maal for reisen vaar.
Glem ikke: jo raskere jeg reiser, desto hoeyere blir betalingen min, og Deres andel ogsaa.

Kureren om bord paa {%s:05}

column2: Carry on please...
column3: Videre, takk...

column2: Payment
column3: Betaling

column2:
My courier voyage ends here.

Today I shall disembark, taking the remaining packages with me. After that I shall not require your services any more, as I intend to pay a social visit on an old acquaintance.
May I take this opportunity to thank you for the speedy transportation.
I am sure that the sum of {%c:03} will strike you as ample reward for your trouble. 
I bow to you with the greatest respect.
Yours sincerely,

Courier on board the {%s:05}
column3:
Min kurerreise slutter her.

I dag gaar jeg i land og tar med meg de gjenvaerende pakkene. Deretter trenger jeg ikke lenger Deres tjenester, for jeg har tenkt aa avlegge en gammel bekjent et besoek.
La meg benytte anledningen til aa takke Dem for den raske transporten.
Jeg er sikker paa at summen {%c:03} vil fortone seg som en rikelig beloenning for bryet.
Jeg bukker for Dem med den stoerste respekt.
Med vennlig hilsen,

Kureren om bord paa {%s:05}

column2: Too slow
column3: For treg

column2:
What a blemish on your reputation!

I must say, this is by far the slowest voyage I have ever made. The next time I think I'd rather travel over hill and dale on an ox-cart or even propel myself through the waves with my own arms than travel with you again!
Now for your payment: its value is equal to that of your word and your reputation - naught. Didn't I make it clear to you when we started our voyage that I was in a hurry?
Too bad. 

Farewell and may we never meet again!
column3:
For en flekk paa Deres rykte!

Jeg maa si at dette er den klart tregeste reisen jeg noen gang har gjort. Neste gang vil jeg heller reise over berg og dal i oksekjerre, eller til og med svoemme gjennom boelgene for egen maskin, enn aa reise med Dem igjen!
Og saa betalingen Deres: den er like mye verdt som Deres ord og Deres rykte, altsaa ingenting. Gjorde jeg det ikke klart for Dem da reisen begynte at jeg hadde daarlig tid?
Synd.

Farvel, og maatte vi aldri moetes igjen!

column2: Treasure map
column3: Skattekart

column2:
\\f1_Greetings,
Now that the light in my eyes is growing dim and eternal rest awaits me, I shall let you into a little secret. Many years ago, when I was chasing a pirate for the Hanseatic League, an influential long distance merchant's ship sank. I later found out that the ship was carrying a valuable cargo. Gold and jewels were said to lie in the watery grave. Unfortunately I never managed to salvage this treasure. Give me a small contribution of {%c:01} to make my twilight years a little sweeter and I'll give you my part of the treasure map.
Are you interested?|\\f1_Thank you, and good luck.
column3:
\\f1_Vaer hilset,
Naa som lyset i oeynene mine svinner og den evige hvile venter, vil jeg innvie Dem i en liten hemmelighet. For mange aar siden, da jeg jaget en pirat for Hansaen, sank skipet til en innflytelsesrik fjernhandler. Senere fant jeg ut at skipet hadde en kostbar last. Gull og juveler skulle ligge i den vaate graven. Dessverre klarte jeg aldri aa berge skatten. Gi meg et lite bidrag paa {%c:01} for aa forsoete alderdommen min, saa gir jeg Dem min del av skattekartet.
Er De interessert?|\\f1_Takk, og lykke til.

column2: Buy
column3: Kjoep

column2:
\\f1_Ahoy there, moneybags,
Pay attention - you're going to have a little adventure. Many years ago, I signed up for the {%Q:05}. Our captain didn't say much about the cargo. But when we were lying in our bunks at night, we would hear muttering about treasure. However, the ship was rotting and couldn't withstand the rigours of the long voyage. It sank, and many sailors and even the captain went with it. I have never had the means to look for the treasure myself. But I'm prepared to sell you my part of the map for the paltry amount of {%c:01}.
Interested?|\\f1_Well, take this piece of my map, then, and I wish you every success.
column3:
\\f1_Ohoi, pengesekk,
Hoer etter, naa skal De faa oppleve et lite eventyr. For mange aar siden moenstret jeg paa {%Q:05}. Kapteinen vaar sa ikke mye om lasten. Men naar vi laa i koeyene om natten, hoerte vi mumling om en skatt. Skipet var imidlertid raattent og taalte ikke paakjenningene paa den lange reisen. Det sank, og mange sjoemenn og til og med kapteinen gikk ned med det. Jeg har aldri hatt raad til aa lete etter skatten selv. Men jeg er villig til aa selge Dem min del av kartet for den luslete summen {%c:01}.
Interessert?|\\f1_Vel, ta da dette stykket av kartet mitt, og jeg oensker Dem all mulig lykke.

column2:
{%7:03},

The nine pieces of the map were divided amongst the crew, and we vanished to all four corners of the earth. I've no idea where the other pieces are, but keep your eyes open in the taverns.

Good luck
column3:
{%7:03},

De ni stykkene av kartet ble delt mellom mannskapet, og vi forsvant til alle verdenshjoerner. Jeg aner ikke hvor de andre stykkene er, men hold oeynene aapne i kneipene.

column3:

Og ett raad foer De gaar: soerg for aa laste andre varer paa skipet ogsaa, saa pakkene ikke blir saa lett oppdaget.

column2:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

I am contacting you to appeal to your magnanimous nature. I run a children's refuge here in {%t:02} for our town's poor and unwanted cherubs.
However, I currently have to rely on donations, as I cannot cover all the costs incurred myself. Would you help us by donating the {%c:04} that we need so urgently?
Obviously I cannot offer you anything in return, but it is not only the town's children who will look favourably upon this act.

{%V:06} {%N:05}
column3:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

Jeg henvender meg til Dem for aa appellere til Deres storsinn. Jeg driver her i {%t:02} et barnehjem for byens fattige og uoenskede smaa engler.
For tiden er jeg imidlertid avhengig av gaver, siden jeg ikke kan dekke alle kostnadene selv. Vil De hjelpe oss ved aa gi de {%c:04} vi saa saart trenger?
Naturligvis kan jeg ikke tilby Dem noe til gjengjeld, men det er ikke bare byens barn som vil se med velvilje paa denne gjerningen.

{%V:06} {%N:05}

column2: Donate

column2:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

My name is {%V:06} {%N:05} and I run the sailors' home in {%t:02}. We take in sailors who can no longer work and who have no one else to turn to. Of course, this responsibility brings with it a lot of expense. We therefore have to rely on donations by our town's more generous residents. Would you donate {%c:04} to us, to help us to get by over the next few weeks?
The inhabitants of this town will certainly look favourably upon this deed too. Please decide within the next week, as the money is needed urgently.
column3:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

Mitt navn er {%V:06} {%N:05}, og jeg driver sjoemannshjemmet i {%t:02}. Vi tar imot sjoemenn som ikke lenger kan arbeide og ikke har andre aa gaa til. Dette ansvaret medfoerer naturligvis store utgifter. Derfor er vi avhengige av gaver fra byens mer gavmilde innbyggere. Vil De gi oss {%c:04} for aa hjelpe oss gjennom de neste ukene?
Byens innbyggere vil sikkert ogsaa se med velvilje paa denne gjerningen. Bestem Dem innen en uke, vaer saa snill, for pengene trengs snarest.

column2:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

I am the Head of Fine Arts here in {%t:02}. But we cannot support our new talent without donations from generous citizens. Would you be prepared to donate the required sum of {%c:04} to us? And a donation will certainly earn you the respect of this town's many art lovers.
We would be very grateful if you would give us your reply within the next seven days.
{%V:06} {%N:05}
column3:
{%1:00}{%V:08} {%N:07},

Jeg er forstander for de skjoenne kunster her i {%t:02}. Men vi kan ikke stoette vaare unge talenter uten gaver fra gavmilde borgere. Vil De vaere villig til aa gi oss den noedvendige summen paa {%c:04}? En gave vil sikkert skaffe Dem respekt hos byens mange kunstelskere.
Vi ville vaere svaert takknemlige om De ga oss Deres svar i loepet av de neste sju dagene.
{%V:06} {%N:05}

Farewell
column3:

God be with you, and may Fortune continue to smile upon you.
column3:
Storartet. De har brakt varene mine til {%t:05} raskt og trygt. Og som jeg lovet Dem fra begynnelsen, har det ikke vaert til Deres skade. Ta imot disse {%c:04} som erstatning for bryet.

column2: Hiding goods

column2:
{%7:00}{%N:05},

Are you an old war-horse like me? If you are, you will certainly appreciate that people like us can sometimes find themselves in a bit of a fix. This is exactly whats happend to me and I ask you for your help.
Could you keep a few of my goods in your warehouse? It wouldn't be for very long and would work to your advantage.
Decide within 10 days.

A man of honour
column3:
{%7:00}{%N:05},

Er De en gammel stridshest som meg? I saa fall forstaar De sikkert at folk som oss iblant kan havne i knipe. Det er akkurat det som har skjedd meg, og jeg ber Dem om hjelp.
Kunne De oppbevare noen av varene mine paa lageret Deres? Det ville ikke vaere lenge og ville vaere til Deres fordel.
Bestem Dem innen 10 dager.

En aeresmann

column2:
{%N:05},

I shan't make a lot of fuss - I'll just come straight to the point. I need to hide my goods and your warehouse would be just the job.
In return, I can offer you more gold than you could hold in your hands.

A man of honour
column3:
{%N:05},

Jeg skal ikke gjoere noe stort nummer av det, men gaar rett paa sak. Jeg maa skjule varene mine, og lageret Deres ville passe perfekt.
Til gjengjeld kan jeg tilby Dem mer gull enn De kan holde i hendene.
Bestem Dem innen 10 dager.

En aeresmann

for your help, which is greatly appreciated. I have already had my goods sent to your warehouse in {%t:04}. They should arrive in {%B:01}{%e:07} in 7 days, packaged and barely distinguishable from packs of {%W:07}.
But I must warn you: people are already looking for my goods. The best camouflage would be for you to put them with another load of {%W:07}.

column3:
Takk

for hjelpen Deres, som jeg setter stor pris paa. Jeg har allerede latt varene mine sende til lageret Deres i {%t:04}. Om 7 dager boer {%B:01}{%e:07} komme fram, pakket inn og knapt til aa skille fra baller med {%W:07}.
Men jeg maa advare Dem: noen leter allerede etter varene mine. Den beste kamuflasjen ville vaere aa legge dem sammen med en annen last {%W:07}.
Jeg henter varene igjen om omtrent 2 uker, og da faar De betalt.

The man of honour

You miserable good-for-nothing,

I did warn you but I'm not going to lose any sleep over you. All you needed to do was hide my goods among your own. And what did you do?
Don't expect a single gold coin for this absolutely disgraceful attempt at carrying out my instructions!
column3:
Din elendige doegenikt,

Jeg advarte Dem, men jeg skal ikke miste nattesoevnen for Deres skyld. Alt De trengte aa gjoere, var aa skjule varene mine blant Deres egne. Og hva gjorde De?
Regn ikke med en eneste gullmynt for dette aldeles skammelige forsoeket paa aa foelge instruksene mine!

column2:
{%7:00}{%N:05},

The man of honour
column3:
{%7:00}{%N:05},

Takk for at De tok vare paa varene mine. Jeg synes De har oppfylt anmodningen min svaert tilfredsstillende, saa jeg haaper De vil anse {%c:02} som en akseptabel godtgjoerelse.

column2: Reputation
column3: Anseelse

column2:
{%1:03}{%R:03} {%n:03},

Don't be too alarmed by this letter, as it is not particularly serious. But it could certainly be worth your while to take notice of what is written here. For some time now, there has been a competition underway between certain members of the Hanseatic League council. The question is: who is the more competent trader, you or your rival, the {%R:04} {%V:04} {%N:04}?
As we have not managed to obtain a clear picture of either contestant's superiority so far, we would like to put the following to you: you must gain fame and recognition among the residents of a town of our choosing, within 50 days. The one with the better reputation at the end of this period will be the winner and will receive a lovely sackful of gold. And the more successful you are, the bigger the prize will be that you take home with you.
You will not find out which town you will need to vanquish until both parties have agreed to the conditions.
Oh, and one more thing: to increase your resolve, a stake of {%c:0C} is required, which will be taken from your account as soon as the contest begins.
Please reply to this within 10 days.

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}
column3:
{%1:03}{%R:03} {%n:03},

Bli ikke altfor forskrekket over dette brevet, det er ikke noe alvorlig. Men det kan sikkert loenne seg aa merke seg det som staar her. En tid har det paagaatt en konkurranse mellom visse medlemmer av Hansaens raad. Spoersmaalet er: hvem er den dyktigste handelsmannen, De eller Deres rival, {%R:04} {%V:04} {%N:04}?
Siden vi saa langt ikke har klart aa danne oss et klart bilde av noen av partenes overlegenhet, foreslaar vi foelgende: De skal vinne beroemmelse og anerkjennelse blant innbyggerne i en by vi velger, innen 50 dager. Den som har best anseelse ved periodens slutt, vinner og faar en fin sekk gull. Og jo mer suksess De har, desto stoerre blir premien De tar med Dem hjem.
Hvilken by De skal erobre, faar De foerst vite naar begge parter har godtatt betingelsene.
Aa, og én ting til: for aa styrke Deres besluttsomhet kreves en innsats paa {%c:0C}, som trekkes fra kontoen Deres saa snart konkurransen begynner.
Svar paa dette innen 10 dager.

Hansaens raad.
{%+:05}

column2:
{%1:04}{%R:04} {%n:04},

Don't be too alarmed by this letter, as it is not particularly serious. But it could certainly be worth your while to take notice of what is written here. For some time now, there has been a bet between certain members of the Hanseatic League council. The question is: who is the more competent trader, you or your rival, the {%R:03} {%V:03} {%N:03}?
As we have not managed to obtain a clear picture of either contestant's superiority so far, we would like to put the following to you: you must gain fame and recognition among the residents of a town of our choosing, within 50 days. The one with the better reputation at the end of this period will be the winner and will receive a lovely sackful of gold. And the more successful you are, the bigger the prize will be that you take home with you.
You will not find out which town you will need to vanquish until both parties have agreed to the conditions.
Oh, and one more thing: to increase your resolve, a stake of {%c:0D} is required, which will be taken from your account as soon as the contest begins.
Please reply to this within 10 days.

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}
column3:
{%1:04}{%R:04} {%n:04},

Bli ikke altfor forskrekket over dette brevet, det er ikke noe alvorlig. Men det kan sikkert loenne seg aa merke seg det som staar her. En tid har det paagaatt et veddemaal mellom visse medlemmer av Hansaens raad. Spoersmaalet er: hvem er den dyktigste handelsmannen, De eller Deres rival, {%R:03} {%V:03} {%N:03}?
Siden vi saa langt ikke har klart aa danne oss et klart bilde av noen av partenes overlegenhet, foreslaar vi foelgende: De skal vinne beroemmelse og anerkjennelse blant innbyggerne i en by vi velger, innen 50 dager. Den som har best anseelse ved periodens slutt, vinner og faar en fin sekk gull. Og jo mer suksess De har, desto stoerre blir premien De tar med Dem hjem.
Hvilken by De skal erobre, faar De foerst vite naar begge parter har godtatt betingelsene.
Aa, og én ting til: for aa styrke Deres besluttsomhet kreves en innsats paa {%c:0D}, som trekkes fra kontoen Deres saa snart konkurransen begynner.
Svar paa dette innen 10 dager.

Hansaens raad.
{%+:05}

column2: Refusal
column3: Avslag

column2:
{%1:02}{%R:02} {%n:02},

Your opponent became thoroughly uneasy at the thought of competing against you. That means our little contest can't take place after all. But it evidently isn't necessary anyway, as it is clear who would have won...

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}
column3:
{%1:02}{%R:02} {%n:02},

Deres motstander ble svaert urolig ved tanken paa aa konkurrere mot Dem. Vaar lille konkurranse kan altsaa likevel ikke finne sted. Men den er tydeligvis heller ikke noedvendig, for det er klart hvem som ville ha vunnet...

Hansaens raad.
{%+:05}

column2: The race is on!
column3: Kapploepet begynner!

column2:
{%1:02}{%R:02} {%N:02},

Your opponent has also agreed to the terms.
So we will tell you the conditions: your town will be {%t:07}. Increase your reputation in this town through trade and donations and see to it that you achieve a better reputation than your opponent within 50 days. Then victory will be yours.
Incidentally, your stake has already been taken from your account.
Good luck,

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}
column3:
{%1:02}{%R:02} {%N:02},

Ogsaa Deres motstander har godtatt betingelsene.
Saa her er reglene: Deres by blir {%t:07}. Oek Deres anseelse i byen gjennom handel og gaver, og soerg for aa faa bedre anseelse enn motstanderen innen 50 dager. Da er seieren Deres.
Innsatsen Deres er forresten allerede trukket fra kontoen Deres.
Lykke til,

Hansaens raad.
{%+:05}

column2: Won
column3: Vunnet

column2:
{%1:03}{%R:03} {%n:03},

There is no longer any doubt about your reputation in {%t:07}: you have won our competition. You have developed a better reputation than your opponent within the allotted time. The {%1:02}{%R:02} {%N:02} must admit defeat, and the prize money is yours. The sum is linked to your results, and comes to a total of {%c:00}.
And perhaps you should consider continuing to look after this town...

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}
column3:
{%1:03}{%R:03} {%n:03},

Det er ikke lenger noen tvil om Deres anseelse i {%t:07}: De har vunnet konkurransen vaar. De har oppnaadd bedre anseelse enn motstanderen innen den fastsatte tiden. {%1:02}{%R:02} {%N:02} maa erkjenne nederlaget, og premiepengene er Deres. Summen avhenger av resultatene Deres og beloeper seg til {%c:00} i alt.
Og kanskje burde De vurdere aa fortsette aa ta Dem av denne byen...

Hansaens raad.
{%+:05}

column2: Lost
column3: Tapt

column2:
{%1:04}{%R:04} {%n:04},

You have been defeated! Your opponent, the victorious {%R:03} {%V:03} {%N:03}, has managed to develop a better reputation than you over the last 50 days, so he walks off with the prize money and your stake too!
But despite everything, please rest assured that the citizens of {%t:07} have benefited from your involvement and extend their gratitude to you.

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:05}
column3:
{%1:04}{%R:04} {%n:04},

De er beseiret! Deres motstander, den seierrike {%R:03} {%V:03} {%N:03}, har klart aa oppnaa bedre anseelse enn De i loepet av de siste 50 dagene og gaar derfor av med premiepengene og innsatsen Deres ogsaa!
Men vaer likevel forvisset om at borgerne i {%t:07} har hatt nytte av Deres engasjement og er Dem takknemlige.

Hansaens raad.
{%+:05}

column2:
Dear traders,

Some people consider me to be old and a bit strange. That's as may be, and yet I am also rich, very rich. To help me pass the time, I'd like to suggest a little game for you and some other traders to play. The rules are very simple.
Some time ago I had a chest hidden, which is now waiting to be discovered. There are coins galore twinkling inside it, but who will be the one to open it? I had its exact location marked on a map and then had several different versions of the map prepared, which I tore into pieces and scattered around all over the place.
The first person to find enough of these pieces will have no trouble locating the treasure. You have 6 weeks to do it.
Send me {%c:1C} to express your interest and I'll count you in for the game. You will then be sent the first piece of the map a few days later. But you need to decide within a week.

Yours graciously,
{%V:1A} {%N:19}
column3:
Kjaere handelsmenn,

Noen anser meg for gammel og litt underlig. Det kan saa vaere, men jeg er ogsaa rik, svaert rik. For aa faa tiden til aa gaa vil jeg foreslaa Dem og noen andre handelsmenn en liten lek. Reglene er svaert enkle.
For en tid siden lot jeg gjemme en kiste som naa venter paa aa bli funnet. Den funkler av mynter i massevis, men hvem blir den som aapner den? Jeg lot den noeyaktige plasseringen merke av paa et kart og fikk deretter laget flere ulike versjoner av kartet, som jeg rev i stykker og spredte vidt omkring.
Den foerste som finner nok av disse stykkene, vil ikke ha problemer med aa finne skatten. De har 6 uker paa dette.
Send meg {%c:1C} som tegn paa Deres interesse, saa regner jeg Dem med i leken. Noen dager senere faar De det foerste kartstykket. Men De maa bestemme Dem innen en uke.

Naadigst,
{%V:1A} {%N:19}

column2:
Congratulations!

The trader {%R:03} {%v:03} {%n:03} has recovered my treasure! So he has certainly earned the {%c:01}.
I have thoroughly enjoyed watching you searching for the treasure, and it was definitely worth every gold coin.

{%V:1A} {%N:19}
column3:
Gratulerer!

Handelsmannen {%R:03} {%v:03} {%n:03} har funnet skatten min! Han har altsaa saa visst fortjent de {%c:01}.
Jeg har hatt stor glede av aa se Dem lete etter skatten, og det var absolutt verdt hver gullmynt.

{%V:1A} {%N:19}

column2:
Dear traders,

Unfortunately, none of the traders has managed to complete my little task within a reasonable time and I am now tired of waiting.
I shall recover the chest again myself and use its contents for a worthy cause.

Farewell,
{%V:1A} {%N:19}
column3:
Kjaere handelsmenn,

Dessverre har ingen av handelsmennene klart aa loese min lille oppgave innen rimelig tid, og naa er jeg lei av aa vente.
Jeg henter selv kisten igjen og bruker innholdet til et godt formaal.

Farvel,
{%V:1A} {%N:19}

column2: Race
column3: Kappseilas

column2:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Some members of the Hanseatic League council would like to organise a race to find out which trader is the fastest.
Would you be interested in taking part? If you do enter, your stake will be 3,000\C, which will be taken from your account before the race begins.
You must make your decision within 10 days. You will also receive further information after this period.

The Hanseatic League council.
{%+:12}
column3:
Kjaere herre eller frue,

Noen medlemmer av Hansaens raad vil gjerne arrangere en kappseilas for aa finne ut hvilken handelsmann som er raskest.
Kunne De tenke Dem aa delta? Melder De Dem paa, er innsatsen 3 000\C, som trekkes fra kontoen Deres foer kappseilasen begynner.
De maa bestemme Dem innen 10 dager. Etter denne fristen faar De ogsaa mer informasjon.

Hansaens raad.
{%+:12}

column2: Participate
column3: Delta

column2: Go!
column3: Start!

column2: Winner
column3: Vinner

column2:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have a winner! The trader {%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02} covered the designated route faster than all the other contestants.
He has therefore well and truly earned his prize money of {%c:14}. 

The Hanseatic League council
{%+:12}
column3:
Kjaere herre eller frue,

Vi har en vinner! Handelsmannen {%R:02} {%v:02} {%n:02} tilbakela den fastsatte ruten raskere enn alle de andre deltakerne.
Han har derfor saa avgjort fortjent premiepengene sine paa {%c:14}.

Hansaens raad
{%+:12}

column2: Cancellation
column3: Avlysning

column2:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Unfortunately, the race has had to be called off, as the participants were unable to keep to the designated times for the race.
But taking this into account, it would have been pointless even to organise a race.

The Hanseatic League council
{%+:12}
column3:
Kjaere herre eller frue,

Dessverre maatte kappseilasen avlyses, siden deltakerne ikke klarte aa holde de fastsatte tidene.
Men sett i det lyset ville det vaert meningsloest aa arrangere en kappseilas i det hele tatt.

Hansaens raad
{%+:12}

column2: Renting storage space
column3: Leie ut lagerplass

column2:
\\f1_Greetings,

My name is {%V:06} {%N:05} and I urgently need storage space for about {%B:07}{%E:01} of my goods. Can you help me?
I'll pay you {%c:01} per week. I can't say how long I'll need the warehouse for, but it will certainly be for several weeks.|\\f1_Thank you so much for your help. I shall have my goods brought to your warehouse immediately.
Take these {%c:0A} as an advance for the next few weeks. I shall pay you the rest when I no longer need the storage space.
column3:
\\f1_Vaer hilset,

Mitt navn er {%V:06} {%N:05}, og jeg trenger snarest lagerplass til omtrent {%B:07}{%E:01} av varene mine. Kan De hjelpe meg?
Jeg betaler Dem {%c:01} i uken. Hvor lenge jeg trenger lageret, kan jeg ikke si, men det blir helt sikkert flere uker.|\\f1_Tusen takk for hjelpen. Jeg lar straks varene mine bringe til lageret Deres.
Ta disse {%c:0A} som forskudd for de neste ukene. Resten betaler jeg naar jeg ikke lenger trenger lagerplassen.

column2: Let
column3: Lei ut

column2: Storage space
column3: Lagerplass

column2:
{%7:02}{%N:09},

Thank you for the storage facilities you have given me. I collected the goods today and have sent you your payment, less the advance. This comes to {%c:01}.
It has been a pleasure doing business with you.

{%V:06} {%N:05}
column3:
{%7:02}{%N:09},

Takk for lagerplassen De har stilt til disposisjon. Jeg hentet varene i dag og har sendt Dem betalingen, minus forskuddet. Det blir {%c:01}.
Det har vaert en fornoeyelse aa handle med Dem.

{%V:06} {%N:05}

column2: Patrol
column3: Patrulje

column2: \\\\f1_Would you like to take on an order for old {%N:06}? I was hoping to send a convoy through several neighbouring towns in the next few days. But I was afraid that one of my competitors might try to hold me up, to ruin my reputation. If you would be good enough to travel along the route with one of your warships, I would spread the rumour that you were travelling on my instructions. That should bring the rats out of their holes! Of course, I shall pay you well for your voyage and on top of that, I shall give you a bonus of {%c:04} for any ambushes that you foil.|\\\\f1_Thank you. My servants will transfer the order to one of your ships in the harbour.
column3: \\\\f1_Vil De paata Dem et oppdrag for gamle {%N:06}? Jeg hadde tenkt aa sende en konvoi gjennom flere nabobyer de naermeste dagene. Men jeg var redd for at en av konkurrentene mine ville proeve aa stanse meg for aa oedelegge ryktet mitt. Om De ville vaere saa snill aa seile ruten med et av Deres orlogsskip, ville jeg spre ryktet om at De seiler paa mine vegne. Det burde lokke rottene ut av hullene sine! Naturligvis betaler jeg Dem godt for reisen, og i tillegg gir jeg Dem en dusoer paa {%c:04} for hvert bakhold De forpurrer.|\\\\f1_Takk. Tjenerne mine overleverer oppdraget til et av skipene Deres i havnen.

column2:
Unfortunately, my servants couldn't find any suitable ships in {%t:00} harbour.

{%N:06}

Dessverre fant tjenerne mine ingen egnede skip i havnen i {%t:00}.

{%N:06}

column2: Patrolled

column2:
Well done!

Now I can be certain that my convoy is not in any danger. Only someone with your courage could have performed this task.
I would therefore like to reward you accordingly. Take these {%c:09} as a token of my gratitude.

{%N:06}
column3:
Godt gjort!

Naa kan jeg vaere sikker paa at konvoien min ikke er i fare. Bare en med Deres mot kunne utfoere denne oppgaven.
Jeg vil derfor beloenne Dem deretter. Ta imot disse {%c:09} som tegn paa min takknemlighet.

{%N:06}

column2: Tutorial
column3: Innfoering

column2: Operating the game interface
column3: Bruk av spillets grensesnitt

column2: In this part of the tutorial, you will learn about the basic principles of using the game interface.
column3: I denne delen av innfoeringen laerer De de grunnleggende prinsippene for bruk av spillets grensesnitt.

column2: Ships
column3: Skip

column2: Ships are the basic capital of every travelling merchant. Travelling, as well as the hiring of sailors and captains will be explained. Ship building and repairing will also be described.
column3: Skip er grunnkapitalen til enhver reisende kjoepmann. Reiser og hyring av sjoemenn og kapteiner blir forklart. Skipsbygging og reparasjon blir ogsaa beskrevet.

column2: Trading
column3: Handel

column2: In this, the most important part of all, you will be told everything worth knowing about trading. This includes, purchasing, selling and the transportation of goods, as well as the system of offers, supply & demand, requirements and consumption. This knowledge will make you into a successful trader.
column3: I denne, den viktigste delen av alle, faar De vite alt som er verdt aa vite om handel: innkjoep, salg og transport av varer, samt systemet med tilbud, etterspoersel, behov og forbruk. Denne kunnskapen vil gjoere Dem til en vellykket handelsmann.

column2: Building towns
column3: Bygge byer

column2: A town is essentially divided into municipal buildings, houses and production facilities. As a simple trader, you can build houses to provide living quarters for new citizens. Building production facilities allows you not only bring those looking for work from the countryside into the town but also allows you to produce raw materials and goods.
column3: En by bestaar i hovedsak av kommunale bygninger, hus og produksjonsanlegg. Som enkel handelsmann kan De bygge hus for aa gi nye borgere bolig. Ved aa bygge produksjonsanlegg trekker De ikke bare arbeidssoekende fra landsbygda inn til byen, men kan ogsaa produsere raavarer og varer.

column2: Sea battles
column3: Sjoeslag

column2: In this last part of the tutorial, you will learn how to manoeuvre a ship during a sea battle as well as how to board enemy ships.
column3: I denne siste delen av innfoeringen laerer De aa manoevrere et skip under et sjoeslag og aa entre fiendtlige skip.

column2: The advancement
column3: Oppstigningen

column2: This campaign is thought of as an introductory campaign. You begin as a small shopkeeper in Luebeck and have to advance to a Patrician in Luebeck within four years. During the campaign, you will receive hints and instructions, in the form of personal news, on how best to achieve your aims.
column3: Denne kampanjen er tenkt som en innfoeringskampanje. De begynner som liten kremmer i Luebeck og skal innen fire aar avansere til patrisier i Luebeck. Underveis i kampanjen faar De tips og anvisninger i form av personlige meldinger om hvordan De best naar maalene Deres.

column2: The flying trader
column3: Den flygende kjoepmannen

column2: You are a young small shopkeeper from a rich Luebeck family. Your private tutor gave you a good comprehensive education, which even at that time anticipated the enlightening spirit of the renaissance. The world to which you are going is marked by deep religiousness and a sailor's superstitious belief in the ship's kobold. Will you make its as a competent trader in this world, as your father before you?
column3: De er en ung, liten kremmer fra en rik familie i Luebeck. Privatlaereren Deres ga Dem en god og bred utdannelse, som allerede varslet renessansens opplyste aand. Verden De trer inn i, er preget av dyp religioesitet og sjoemennenes overtroiske tro paa skipsnissen. Vil De klare Dem i denne verden som en dyktig handelsmann, slik Deres far gjorde foer Dem?

column2: Campaign: Rise of the Hanseatic League
column3: Kampanje: Hansaens oppsving

column2:
The Hanseatic League is in an appalling state. Corruption and pirates have been the ruin of many a town.
You have been away for many years voyaging south in search of new countries and business opportunities. On your return you find your business in tatters. The once prosperous town of Rostock, your hometown that you helped to thrive, seems to have been set back to almost the state you found it in.
Your friends on the council, however, have not forgotten you. Your hard work and honesty made you a well-respected and highly trusted council member. They therefore put their faith in you to rebuild the Hanseatic League. You will receive whatever support they can offer. Just don't expect too much.
Your first task is to get your operation in Rostock back up to speed. Once this is achieved, you can then turn your attentions to the other towns. You goal is to double the number of inhabitants in the Hanseatic League over the next 15 months.
Not an easy task, but achievable.
column3:
Hansaen er i en soergelig forfatning. Korrupsjon og pirater har vaert mang en bys undergang.
De har i mange aar vaert paa reiser soerover paa jakt etter nye land og forretningsmuligheter. Ved hjemkomsten finner De forretningen Deres i ruiner. Den en gang saa velstaaende byen Rostock, Deres hjemby som De hjalp til aa blomstre, ser ut til aa ha falt tilbake nesten til den tilstanden De en gang fant den i.
Vennene Deres i raadet har likevel ikke glemt Dem. Deres harde arbeid og aerlighet gjorde Dem til et hoeyt respektert og betrodd raadsmedlem. Derfor setter de sin lit til at De bygger opp Hansaen igjen. De faar all den stoetten de kan gi. Bare ikke forvent for mye.
Deres foerste oppgave er aa faa virksomheten i Rostock i gang igjen. Naar det er gjort, kan De vende Dem mot de andre byene. Maalet Deres er aa doble antallet innbyggere i Hansaen i loepet av de neste 15 maanedene.
Ingen lett oppgave, men den lar seg gjoere.

column2: Mission: Reorganisation
column3: Oppdrag: Saneringen

column2: How could this have happened? You have just returned from a cultural visit to the Mediterranean and severely regret your decision of entrusting your business to your cousin. In a few short months his sterling efforts have ensured that the business has almost reached a total state of collapse. Your accountants are wringing their hands, your workers and crews are scared for their jobs and the citizens fear an economic disaster.\nYou are going to have to roll your sleeves up and get stuck in. Over the next 3 months your fortune has got to be restored to exactly the same level as before you left. And that used to be a cool 3 million!
column3: Hvordan kunne dette skje? De har nettopp kommet hjem fra en dannelsesreise til Middelhavet og angrer bittert paa at De betrodde forretningen Deres til fetteren Deres. Paa noen faa maaneder har hans prisverdige anstrengelser foert forretningen nesten til fullstendig sammenbrudd. Bokholderne Deres vrir hendene, arbeiderne og mannskapene Deres frykter for jobbene sine, og borgerne frykter en oekonomisk katastrofe.\nDe maa brette opp ermene og ta fatt. I loepet av de neste 3 maanedene maa formuen Deres tilbake til noeyaktig samme nivaa som foer De reiste. Og det var hele 3 millioner!

column2: Mission: Poor Harvest
column3: Oppdrag: Uaar

column2: A late spring and relatively cool summer has caused a poor wheat harvest throughout the Hanseatic League area. Autumn already sees most of the wheat stocks depleted. The prospect of a severe famine threatens to empty the towns of its citizens.\nFortunately you have invested in fish and meat production facilities. Your task begins in November 1357. You have fisherman's huts in your hometown of Luebeck and cattle farms in Aalborg. You also have quite a bit of stock at your disposal. You should use your stocks of wheat and beer wisely, you will not be able to replenish them.\nYou will have succeeded in your task if the total population in the Hanseatic League area has not been reduced by more than 4000 inhabitants by the end of March, when wheat production restarts.
column3: En sen vaar og en forholdsvis kjoelig sommer har gitt daarlig hveteavling i hele Hansaens omraade. Allerede om hoesten er de fleste hvetelagrene oppbrukt. Utsikten til en alvorlig hungersnoed truer med aa toemme byene for innbyggere.\nHeldigvis har De investert i produksjonsanlegg for fisk og kjoett. Oppgaven Deres begynner i november 1357. De har fiskerhytter i hjembyen Deres Luebeck og kvegbruk i Aalborg. De har ogsaa et pent lager til disposisjon. Bruk lagrene av hvete og oel med omtanke, for De vil ikke kunne fylle dem opp igjen.\nDe har lykkes med oppgaven hvis den samlede befolkningen i Hansaens omraade ikke har sunket med mer enn 4000 innbyggere ved utgangen av mars, naar hveteproduksjonen kommer i gang igjen.

column2: Mission: The Fire
column3: Oppdrag: Brannen

column2: You are a rich merchant in Luebeck. Your task starts a week before a large outbreak of fire there, which will see many of your buildings go up in flames. Your task is to rebuild the town after the fire. You have got 6 months to get the number of inhabitants up to the same level as before the fire.
column3: De er en rik kjoepmann i Luebeck. Oppgaven Deres begynner en uke foer en stor brann der, som vil legge mange av bygningene Deres i aske. Oppgaven Deres er aa bygge opp byen igjen etter brannen. De har 6 maaneder paa aa faa antallet innbyggere opp paa samme nivaa som foer brannen.

column2: Mission: The Black Death
column3: Oppdrag: Svartedauden

column2: The year of 1347 saw the beginnings of the great plague. This massive epidemic started in the Mediterranean and then gradually spread Northwest and later eastwards. Times of great economic uncertainty and disaster began in all countries bordering the Baltic and North Sea, with England being particularly badly affected. Sea trade was disrupted massively.\nYou start this mission as a travelling merchant in Gdansk in the year of 1349, shortly before the plague breaks out in London. You have about a month before the plague will start spreading through the German towns of Cologne, Hamburg, Bremen, Luebeck, Rostock and Gdansk. Your task is to supply these towns during the epidemic, and to help them prosper again once the plague has passed. Timely boosting of a town's healthcare provisions can influence the plague's duration and spread.\nThe original number of inhabitants in the Hanseatic League needs to be restored within 4 months of this mission's start to have successfully completed this mission.
column3: Aaret 1347 saa begynnelsen paa den store pesten. Denne veldige epidemien begynte i Middelhavsomraadet og spredte seg deretter gradvis mot nordvest og senere oestover. En tid med stor oekonomisk usikkerhet og katastrofer begynte i alle land rundt Oestersjoeen og Nordsjoeen, og England ble saerlig hardt rammet. Sjoehandelen ble kraftig forstyrret.\nDe begynner dette oppdraget som reisende kjoepmann i Gdansk i aaret 1349, kort foer pesten bryter ut i London. De har omtrent en maaned foer pesten begynner aa spre seg gjennom de tyske byene Cologne, Hamburg, Bremen, Luebeck, Rostock og Gdansk. Oppgaven Deres er aa forsyne disse byene under epidemien og hjelpe dem aa blomstre igjen naar pesten er over. Ved aa styrke en bys helsestell i tide kan De paavirke pestens varighet og spredning.\nFor aa lykkes med oppdraget maa det opprinnelige antallet innbyggere i Hansaen vaere gjenopprettet innen 4 maaneder etter at oppdraget begynte.

column2: \\f1_Welcome to Patrician 3, the maritime trading simulation set in the period of the Hanseatic League.\nIn this introduction, you will learn how to develop from a simple shopkeeper to a travelling merchant.\nYou can use the two buttons to the right of this text to move forwards and backwards between each step of this tutorial.
column3: \\f1_Velkommen til Patrician 3, handelssimulasjonen til sjoes i Hansaens tid.\nI denne innfoeringen laerer De hvordan De utvikler Dem fra vanlig kjoepmann til reisende handelsmann.\nMed de to knappene til hoeyre for teksten kan De gaa frem og tilbake mellom trinnene i denne oevelsen.

column2:
\f1_The tutorial is divided into several parts. In this part you will learn about the operation of the game console.

\f0_Instructions
\f1_You should choose an interface resolution of at least 1024 x 768 for this tutorial.
column3:
\f1_Oevelsen er delt inn i flere deler. I denne delen laerer De aa betjene spillets brukergrensesnitt.

\f0_Anvisninger
\f1_Til denne oevelsen boer De velge en skjermopploesning paa minst 1024 x 768.

column2: \\f1_Let us first look at the divisions of the game interface layout. It consists of five parts.\n\\f0_Main view\n\\f1_Towns and the nautical maps are shown here. At the beginning of a game you will always start in your home town, which, in this case, is Lubeck.
column3: \\f1_La oss foerst se paa hvordan spillets brukergrensesnitt er inndelt. Det bestaar av fem deler.\n\\f0_Hovedvisning\n\\f1_Her vises byene og sjoekartene. I begynnelsen av et spill starter De alltid i hjembyen Deres, som i dette tilfellet er Luebeck.

column2: \\f1_The main view only shows a section of the town. Move the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen or use the arrows on the keyboard to change the view
column3: \\f1_Hovedvisningen viser bare en del av byen. Flytt musepekeren til skjermkanten, eller bruk piltastene paa tastaturet for aa endre visningen.

column2: \\f0_Mini-Map\n\\f1_Shows the whole area of the town. The rectangle indicates the displayed area. Change this display by using the mouse to move the rectangle.
column3: \\f0_Minikart\n\\f1_Viser hele byens omraade. Rektangelet viser den delen som vises. Endre visningen ved aa flytte rektangelet med musen.

column2: \\f0_Title Bar\n\\f1_The title bar is placed at the top of the screen. If you are in a town, it will show the following, from left to right: population, the name of the town, the number of your buildings in the town, your money and the date.\nThere are also buttons hidden behind the small symbols on the title bar.
column3: \\f0_Tittellinje\n\\f1_Tittellinjen sitter oeverst paa skjermen. Hvis De er i en by, viser den fra venstre mot hoeyre: innbyggertall, byens navn, antall bygninger De eier i byen, pengene Deres og datoen.\nBak de smaa symbolene i tittellinjen finnes det dessuten skjulte knapper.

column2: \\f0_Population Button\n\\f1_Click onto the population symbol in order to see the population distribution and the satisfaction of the citizens of this town. If arrows are visible behind satisfaction, then they indicate whether the citizens are becoming more, or less satisfied.
column3: \\f0_Knappen Befolkning\n\\f1_Klikk paa befolkningssymbolet for aa se fordelingen av innbyggerne og tilfredsheten blant byens borgere. Hvis det staar piler bak tilfredsheten, viser de om borgerne blir mer eller mindre tilfredse.

column2: \\f0_Building Button\n\\f1_The building symbol changes the view of a building. You use it to differentiate between your own and other buildings.
column3: \\f0_Knappen Bygninger\n\\f1_Bygningssymbolet endrer visningen av bygninger. Med det skiller De mellom Deres egne og andres bygninger.

column2: \\f0_Money Button\n\\f1_If you click the money symbol, a window with the statistics menu will be opened. However, this menu will not be explained in this tutorial. To close a window, either click onto the close button at the bottom right hand corner of the window, or right click.
column3: \\f0_Knappen Penger\n\\f1_Hvis De klikker paa pengesymbolet, aapnes et vindu med statistikkmenyen. Denne menyen forklares imidlertid ikke i denne oevelsen. For aa lukke et vindu klikker De paa lukkeknappen nederst i vinduets hoeyre hjoerne eller hoeyreklikker.

column2: \\f0_Chronicle\n\\f1The chronicle is hidden behind the hourglass. The chronicle contains important public information. It is worth looking into it every so often, to keep yourself up-to-date about events in the Hanse. Close the chronicle by using either the close button or a right click.
column3: \\f0_Kroenike\n\\f1Kroeniken er skjult bak timeglasset. Kroeniken inneholder viktige offentlige opplysninger. Det loenner seg aa se i den av og til for aa holde seg à jour med hendelsene i Hansaen. Lukk kroeniken med lukkeknappen eller med et hoeyreklikk.

column2: \\f0_Selection or Election Window\n\\f1_Information about selected ships is displayed here. Now, let us test it.\nShift the cursor to the harbour of the town. You will see a ship by the name of "Viking". This is your ship. Click on it in order to select it.
column3: \\f0_Utvalgsvindu\n\\f1_Her vises opplysninger om de valgte skipene. La oss proeve det.\nFlytt pekeren til byens havn. De ser et skip som heter "Viking". Det er Deres skip. Klikk paa det for aa velge det.

column2: \\f1_The selection window will now display information about the selected ship. You will see the ship's location under its name. If it is sent somewhere else, you will also see the destination here. The ship's load is next to it. The uppermost number shows the capacity; the number in the middle shows how much space goods have taken up. Finally, the number below shows how much space is required for crew and armament.
column3: \\f1_Utvalgsvinduet viser naa opplysninger om det valgte skipet. Under navnet ser De hvor skipet befinner seg. Hvis det sendes et annet sted, ser De ogsaa destinasjonen her. Ved siden av staar skipets last. Det oeverste tallet angir kapasiteten; tallet i midten viser hvor mye plass varene tar. Det nederste tallet viser til slutt hvor mye plass som kreves til mannskap og bevaepning.

column2: \\f1_Apart from that, the ship's speed in knots, the condition of the ship from 0 to 100%, and the crew are displayed here.\nNext to that is the armament strength of the ship.
column3: \\f1_Dessuten vises her skipets fart i knop, skipets tilstand fra 0 til 100 % og mannskapet.\nVed siden av staar skipets bevaepningsstyrke.

column2: \\f1_Under that, you will see a list of all the goods on board. Note that there are two units of measurement: load and barrels. One load equals exactly 10 barrels.
column3: \\f1_Under det ser De en liste over alle varer om bord. Merk at det finnes to maaleenheter: last og toenne. En last tilsvarer noeyaktig 10 toenner.

column2: \\f0_Button Bar\n\\f1_Let's look at the button bar and go through them from left to right.\nThe first button displays the list of ships. Please click it.
column3: \\f0_Knapperekke\n\\f1_La oss se paa knapperekken og gaa gjennom knappene fra venstre mot hoeyre.\nDen foerste knappen viser skipslisten. Klikk paa den.

column2: \\f1_You can see which ships belong to you, what their names are, and where they are at the moment. You only have one ship in this tutorial; therefore the ship's list is displaying one ship only.\nThe ship list shows the name, type of ship, status and location, load and the value of the goods on board. You can switch between the display showing crew and armament by using the button below the list.
column3: \\f1_De kan se hvilke skip som tilhoerer Dem, hva de heter, og hvor de befinner seg akkurat naa. I denne oevelsen har De bare ett skip; derfor viser skipslisten bare ett skip.\nSkipslisten viser navn, skipstype, status og plassering, last og verdien av varene om bord. Med knappen under listen bytter De mellom visning av mannskap og bevaepning.

column2: \\f1_Incidentally, there is a "go to" button to the left of each ship in the ship-list. If you click on this button, it will go to the spot where the ship is placed. This can be in another town or at sea. Try it out, in order to bring the ship "Viking" into your field of vision.\nThen close the ship list.
column3: \\f1_Til venstre for hvert skip paa skipslisten finnes for oevrig en knapp "gaa til". Hvis De klikker paa den, gaar visningen til stedet der skipet er, noe som kan vaere i en annen by eller paa havet. Proev det for aa faa skipet "Viking" inn i synsfeltet.\nLukk deretter skipslisten.

column2: \\f1_The next button is the fast-forward. If you press it, the running time will be speeded up. Meanwhile, you can follow all your ships on the complete map. The fast-forward ends as soon as you press a mouse button, or one of your ships goes to anchor in a harbour.
column3: \\f1_Den neste knappen er spol frem. Hvis De trykker paa den, gaar tiden raskere. I mellomtiden kan De foelge alle skipene Deres paa det samlede kartet. Spol frem stopper saa snart De trykker paa en museknapp, eller et av skipene Deres kaster anker i en havn.

column2: \\f1_The news menu is hidden behind the next button. All the letters you have received are filed here. Click on this button and you will see the news menu, in which various news items have been filed. Click onto one of the topics and then onto news-item, in order to read it.\nClose the news, in the same way as with all other windows by using the close button or with a right click.
column3: \\f1_Nyhetsmenyen er skjult bak den neste knappen. Alle brevene De mottar, arkiveres her. Klikk paa knappen, saa ser De nyhetsmenyen, hvor ulike nyheter er arkivert. Klikk paa et av emnene og deretter paa en nyhet for aa lese den.\nLukk nyhetene som alle andre vinduer med lukkeknappen eller med et hoeyreklikk.

column2: \\f1_You can use the last but one button on the news menu to configure the letters-file so that letters can automatically be deleted later on. You can also delete a letter by clicking it and then clicking the "delete" button on the right of the news menu.
column3: \\f1_Med den nest siste knappen i nyhetsmenyen kan De stille inn brevarkivet slik at brev slettes automatisk senere. De kan ogsaa slette et brev ved aa klikke paa det og deretter paa knappen "slett" til hoeyre i nyhetsmenyen.

column2: \\f1_The next button on the button bar is the construction menu. You can use this menu to construct buildings in towns where you have a trading office. The trading office is simultaneously the home, office and warehouse of a trader.\nTrading office and building menu will be explained in the chapter after the next.
column3: \\f1_Den neste knappen paa knapperekken er byggemenyen. Med denne menyen bygger De bygninger i byer der De har et handelskontor. Handelskontoret er paa én gang en kjoepmanns hjem, kontor og lager.\nHandelskontoret og byggemenyen forklares i kapitlet etter det neste.

column2: \\f1_If you click the town gate button, you leave the town and end up on the sea map.\nInstead of the town, the sea map will be displayed. You can as usual shift the clip by using the arrow keys on the keyboard.
column3: \\f1_Hvis De klikker paa knappen med byporten, forlater De byen og kommer til sjoekartet.\nI stedet for byen vises sjoekartet. Som vanlig kan De flytte visningen med piltastene paa tastaturet.

column2: \\f1_All towns, and your ships will be displayed on the sea map. Naval events and foreign ships are also visible here.\nYou can enter any town in which you have ships or buildings from this map. In this tutorial, you are only represented in Lubeck.
column3: \\f1_Paa sjoekartet vises alle byer og skipene Deres. Sjoehendelser og fremmede skip er ogsaa synlige her.\nFra dette kartet kan De gaa inn i enhver by der De har skip eller bygninger. I denne oevelsen er De bare representert i Luebeck.

column2: \\f1_Incidentally, the title bar has changed. As you are no longer in a town, four ship buttons are displayed. You can switch between ships using these buttons. However, there will be differences between anchored and sailing ships, and convoys.
column3: \\f1_Tittellinjen har forresten endret seg. Siden De ikke lenger er i en by, vises fire skipsknapper. Med dem bytter De mellom skip. Det er imidlertid forskjell paa skip for anker, seilende skip og konvoier.

column2: \\f1_Apart from that the display will show how many ships are at anchor in a harbour or waiting for new orders.\nShips that are at the shipyard for repairs or expansion are not shown, because they cannot be given orders.
column3: \\f1_Dessuten viser skjermen hvor mange skip som ligger for anker i en havn eller venter paa nye ordrer.\nSkip som ligger paa verftet for reparasjon eller utbygging, vises ikke, fordi de ikke kan faa ordrer.

column2: \\f1_To leave the map and get back to Lubeck, click the blue button near Lubeck on the map. The last button on the far right of the button bar takes you to the options-menu. You can load games and save them, as well as ending the game here.
column3: \\f1_For aa forlate kartet og vende tilbake til Luebeck maa De klikke paa den blaa knappen ved Luebeck paa kartet. Den siste knappen helt til hoeyre paa knapperekken foerer til innstillingsmenyen. Her kan De laste og lagre spill og avslutte spillet.

column2: \\f1_Yet another tip for operating with the mouse:\nYou can select objects such as ships and buildings by using the left click. By using a right click you can send the selected ship to another location. Apart from that, the right click is used to close a window in the main view.
column3: \\f1_Enda et tips om bruk av musen:\nMed venstreklikk velger De objekter som skip og bygninger. Med hoeyreklikk sender De det valgte skipet til et annet sted. Dessuten brukes hoeyreklikk til aa lukke et vindu i hovedvisningen.

column2: \\f1_Tutorial 1 ends here. Click on the "continue" button to end this chapter and to start the next one. Or select "End game" in the options-menu, to get back to the main menu.
column3: \\f1_Oevelse 1 slutter her. Klikk paa knappen "fortsett" for aa avslutte dette kapitlet og starte det neste. Eller velg "Avslutt spillet" i innstillingsmenyen for aa vende tilbake til hovedmenyen.

column2: \\f1_Welcome to chapter two of the tutorial. In this part of the tutorial, we will have a closer look at the ships, including areas such as travelling and the signing up of captain and crew.\nNow click the forward button to continue.
column3: \\f1_Velkommen til oevelsens andre kapittel. I denne delen ser vi naermere paa skipene, blant annet temaer som reiser og ansettelse av kaptein og mannskap.\nKlikk naa paa fremknappen for aa fortsette.

column2: \\f1_You are in the town of Lubeck. Move the displayed area to the harbour and select the ship "Viking" by left clicking on it. The ship will then appear in the lower right selection window.\nNow look at this window in detail.
column3: \\f1_De befinner Dem i byen Luebeck. Flytt visningen til havnen, og velg skipet "Viking" med et venstreklikk. Skipet vises da i utvalgsvinduet nederst til hoeyre.\nSe naa naermere paa dette vinduet.

column2: \\f1_There is an anchor and the town name, Lubeck, underneath the name of the ship. The anchor and the location indicate that the ship is at anchor in Lubeck. Instead of an anchor there could be another symbol, for example, when the ship is at sea, but we will come to that later.
column3: \\f1_Under skipets navn er det et anker og byens navn, Luebeck. Ankeret og stedet viser at skipet ligger for anker i Luebeck. I stedet for et anker kan det vaere et annet symbol, for eksempel naar skipet er paa havet, men det kommer vi til senere.

column2: \\f1_In the line below, the display will first of all show the speed of the ship in knots. Of course, in the habour the speed shown is 0. Next to that you will see the condition of the ship, which, at the moment is 100%, the ship is therefore in tip-top condition.
column3: \\f1_Paa linjen under viser skjermen foerst skipets fart i knop. I havnen er farten naturligvis 0. Ved siden av ser De skipets tilstand, som akkurat naa er 100 %; skipet er altsaa i toppform.

column2: \\f1_To the right you see the crew and armament of the ship. The figure indicates the number of sailors on board. The star means that there is a captain on board.\nThere are large and small balls displayed under the weapons symbol. Only a maximum of five balls can be displayed here, five small balls are equal to one large ball.
