column3: \\f1_Til hoeyre ser De skipets mannskap og bevaepning. Tallet angir antall sjoefolk om bord. Stjernen betyr at det er en kaptein om bord.\nUnder vaapensymbolet vises store og smaa kuler. Det kan hoeyst vises fem kuler; fem smaa kuler tilsvarer en stor.

column2: \\f1_The large barrel shows the ship's load. As already mentioned, the uppermost figure to the right of the barrel shows the ship's capacity. How much space goods have taken up is indicated underneath. The lowest figure shows how much space isrequired for the crew and the weapons. As there are no goods on board now, the mid-figure is at 0.
column3: \\f1_Den store toennen viser skipets last. Som allerede nevnt angir det oeverste tallet til hoeyre for toennen skipets kapasitet. Under vises det hvor mye plass varene tar. Det nederste tallet viser hvor mye plass som kreves til mannskap og vaapen. Siden det ikke er noen varer om bord naa, staar tallet i midten paa 0.

column2: \\f1_Later on, the list of goods will be displayed in the blank space below these instructions.
column3: \\f1_Senere vises varelisten i det tomme feltet under disse anvisningene.

column2: \\f1_Let's now move on to the other buttons in the ship's menu. First of all, there is the crew information. Click the "crew" button. This once again shows the number of sailors and the amount of their daily pay. As the ship is at anchor, you can dismiss sailors and captain. However, you shouldn't do that now.
column3: \\f1_La oss naa gaa videre til de andre knappene i skipsmenyen. Foerst er det mannskapsopplysningene. Klikk paa knappen "mannskap". Den viser igjen antall sjoefolk og beloepet paa den daglige loennen deres. Siden skipet ligger for anker, kan De avskjedige sjoefolk og kaptein. Det boer De imidlertid ikke gjoere naa.

column2: \\f1_Below the captain you can see three values: Trading bonus, travel bonus and naval battle bonus. A captain has the following standing. The older he is, the more experienced he is.\nThe other buttons in the ship's menu are not too interesting during the first few hours of the game and are explained in the handbook.
column3: \\f1_Under kapteinen ser De tre verdier: handelsbonus, reisebonus og sjoeslagsbonus. En kaptein har foelgende anseelse. Jo eldre han er, desto mer erfaren er han.\nDe oevrige knappene i skipsmenyen er ikke saa interessante i spillets foerste timer og forklares i haandboken.

column2: \\f1_We will now send the ship to another town. To do that, you have to select a ship. Now click the button, "leave town" on the button bar above the ship's menu.\nThis will display the large sea map.
column3: \\f1_Naa sender vi skipet til en annen by. Til det maa De velge et skip. Klikk naa paa knappen "forlat byen" paa knapperekken over skipsmenyen.\nDa vises det store sjoekartet.

column2: \\f1_As advised, if the ship is still selected, the town in which the ship is placed will be shown centrally. As the ship is at anchor in the port, you cannot see it directly on this map. However, you can see a small banner with a ship and a number next to the town of Lubeck. This is the number of ships that you have in the town.
column3: \\f1_Som nevnt vises byen der skipet befinner seg, i midten hvis skipet fortsatt er valgt. Siden skipet ligger for anker i havnen, kan De ikke se det direkte paa dette kartet. Men ved siden av byen Luebeck ser De et lite flagg med et skip og et tall. Det er antall skip De har i byen.

column2: \\f1_Now click on this banner to display the ships in more detail. As you can see, the known ship list is opened. It shows all ships being at anchor in the town. Now click the "Lydia" in the list and note how the selection window displays it.
column3: \\f1_Klikk naa paa dette flagget for aa faa vist skipene mer detaljert. Som De ser, aapnes listen over kjente skip. Den viser alle skip som ligger for anker i byen. Klikk naa paa "Lydia" paa listen, og se hvordan utvalgsvinduet viser henne.

column2: \\f1_By clicking on the arrow on the left next to the ship's name you select the ship and centre it on the monitor while the ship list is being closed. Alternatively, you could also double click on the ship's name. Practice this a few times and re-open the ship list by clicking the banner next to the town of Lubeck.
column3: \\f1_Ved aa klikke paa pilen til venstre for skipets navn velger De skipet og sentrerer det paa skjermen, mens skipslisten lukkes. Alternativt kan De ogsaa dobbeltklikke paa skipets navn. Oev Dem paa det et par ganger, og aapne skipslisten igjen ved aa klikke paa flagget ved siden av byen Luebeck.

column2: \\f1_Now select the ship "Viking" again and close the ship's list. The ship will be displayed in the middle of the screen. Now, drag the sea map to the right and upwards until the town of Riga is displayed. Now do a right click on the red button near Riga, in order to give the ship the destination of Riga.
column3: \\f1_Velg naa skipet "Viking" igjen, og lukk skipslisten. Skipet vises midt paa skjermen. Dra naa sjoekartet mot hoeyre og oppover til byen Riga vises. Hoeyreklikk naa paa den roede knappen ved Riga for aa gi skipet Riga som maal.

column2: \\f1_The selection window now shows the changed status of the ship. Instead of an anchor symbol, you will now see a ship, and Riga as the town of destination. The estimated time of the journey in days is also shown.
column3: \\f1_Utvalgsvinduet viser naa skipets endrede status. I stedet for ankeret ser De naa et skip og Riga som destinasjonsby. Den antatte reisetiden i dager vises ogsaa.

column2: \\f1_You may have noticed, that it took a while before the ship became visible at sea. The reason for this is that the ship spends some time in the harbour before appearing on the sea map.
column3: \\f1_Kanskje har De lagt merke til at det varte litt foer skipet ble synlig paa havet. Det skyldes at skipet bruker litt tid i havnen foer det dukker opp paa sjoekartet.

column2: \\f1_Incidentally, as soon as the ship is on the sea map, you will also see it on the mini map. Your ships have blue squares; selected ones have flashing squares. Sometimes also white squares are visible. These are ships of your competitors being within visible range of one of your ships.
column3: \\f1_Foroevrig ser De skipet ogsaa paa minikartet saa snart det er paa sjoekartet. Skipene Deres er blaa firkanter; valgte blinker. Noen ganger er det ogsaa hvite firkanter synlige. Det er konkurrenters skip som befinner seg innenfor synsvidde av et av skipene Deres.

column2: \\f1_Now that the ship is on the way, we have got a bit more time to have a closer look at the sea map. Move the map in such a way that Lubeck becomes visible again. While all other towns have a red button, Lubeck has a blue one; showing that Lubeck is your hometown.
column3: \\f1_Naa som skipet er paa vei, har vi litt mer tid til aa se naermere paa sjoekartet. Flytt kartet slik at Luebeck blir synlig igjen. Mens alle andre byer har en roed knapp, har Luebeck en blaa; det viser at Luebeck er hjembyen Deres.

column2: \\f1_As soon as you have set up a trading office in another town a blue spot appears on the red button. In this way, you can easily see in which towns you have trading offices.\nAll your property and towns are always indicated in blue.
column3: \\f1_Saa snart De har opprettet et handelskontor i en annen by, dukker det opp en blaa flekk paa den roede knappen. Paa den maaten ser De lett i hvilke byer De har handelskontorer.\nAlle eiendommene og byene Deres angis alltid med blaatt.

column2: \\f1_And remember: You can always recognise which towns you have ships at anchor by the banner next to the town. Click once more on the banner next to Lubeck. As there is only one ship in the town, it will be selected at once. It is the Lydia. Now do a right click on any point you wish in the middle of the ocean.
column3: \\f1_Og husk: De kan alltid se i hvilke byer De har skip for anker, paa flagget ved siden av byen. Klikk enda en gang paa flagget ved siden av Luebeck. Siden det bare er ett skip i byen, blir det valgt med en gang. Det er Lydia. Hoeyreklikk naa paa et vilkaarlig punkt midt ute paa havet.

column2: \\f1_With this right click you have instructed the ship to carry out an action, in this case, sailing to a position on the sea map. After a while, the ship becomes visible on the sea map.\nClick the left mouse button on an empty space in the ocean. This cancels all previous selections.
column3: \\f1_Med dette hoeyreklikket har De gitt skipet ordre om aa utfoere en handling, i dette tilfellet aa seile til en posisjon paa sjoekartet. Etter en stund blir skipet synlig paa sjoekartet.\nKlikk med venstre museknapp paa et tomt sted i havet. Da oppheves alle tidligere markeringer.

column2: \\f1_Now wait until "Viking" arrives in Riga.\nAs soon as it arrives, the banner next to the town becomes visible. Left click  the red button, in order to enter the town. Note: you can only enter towns where you have a trading office or a ship at anchor.
column3: \\f1_Vent naa til "Viking" ankommer Riga.\nSaa snart det ankommer, blir flagget ved siden av byen synlig. Venstreklikk paa den roede knappen for aa gaa inn i byen. Merk: De kan bare gaa inn i byer der De har et handelskontor eller et skip for anker.

column2: \\f1_Now look at the mini map. It displays all buildings and streets of the town; the harbour and your ship are also visible. There is a button with an arrow on the left next to the map, click on it.
column3: \\f1_Se naa paa minikartet. Det viser alle bygninger og gater i byen; havnen og skipet Deres er ogsaa synlige. Til venstre for kartet er det en knapp med en pil; klikk paa den.

column2: \\f1_You can use this button to switch between the sea map or the town map, but only when you are in a town. The nice thing about it, is that you can send your ship to another town without having to leave the town you are in.
column3: \\f1_Med denne knappen bytter De mellom sjoekartet og bykartet, men bare naar De er i en by. Det fine er at De kan sende skipet Deres til en annen by uten aa maatte forlate byen De er i.

column2: \\f1_The towns are shown on the mini map by small diamonds. Look at the town at the very top of the map. This is Bergen. Now look for your ship in the harbour of Riga, select it, and right click on Bergen. As confirmation, the town flashes up for a moment, if it doesn't, then you have missed it and you should try again.
column3: \\f1_Paa minikartet vises byene som smaa romber. Se paa byen helt oeverst paa kartet. Det er Bergen. Finn naa skipet Deres i havnen i Riga, velg det, og hoeyreklikk paa Bergen. Som bekreftelse blinker byen et oeyeblikk; hvis den ikke gjoer det, har De truffet ved siden av og maa proeve igjen.

column2: \\f1_Through the right click you have given your ship a new destination. The ship will sail to this destination and wait for further instructions.\nSo that we do not have to wait for too long for the ship to reach its destination, let's look at the fast forward.
column3: \\f1_Med hoeyreklikket har De gitt skipet Deres et nytt maal. Skipet seiler til dette maalet og venter paa ytterligere instrukser.\nFor ikke aa maatte vente for lenge paa at skipet naar maalet sitt, ser vi paa spol frem.

column2: \\f1_Click the "forward" button on the button bar using a left click. You will see at a total map of the whole see area, as well as all the ships that are on their way. Apart from that the time runs very quickly. The map remains displayed until a ship has reached its destination or you press a mouse button.
column3: \\f1_Klikk med venstre museknapp paa knappen "frem" paa knapperekken. De ser et samlet kart over hele sjoeomraadet og alle skip som er paa vei. Dessuten gaar tiden veldig raskt. Kartet forblir vist til et skip har naadd maalet sitt, eller De trykker paa en museknapp.

column2: \\f1_Press the button whenever you are waiting for a ship to go to anchor. You will notice later on that there are other situations where the fast-forward ends automatically.\nWe will now wait until the "Viking" arrives in Bergen.
column3: \\f1_Trykk paa knappen hver gang De venter paa at et skip skal kaste anker. De vil senere oppdage at spol frem stopper automatisk i andre situasjoner.\nNaa venter vi til "Viking" ankommer Bergen.

column2: \\f1_Now enter Bergen by left clicking on it. Is your ship "Viking" still selected? If not, search for it in the harbour of Bergen and select it. As you can see, the journey has left its mark: the condition of the ship is no longer 100%. Therefore we have to repair it.
column3: \\f1_Gaa naa inn i Bergen med et venstreklikk. Er skipet Deres "Viking" fortsatt valgt? Hvis ikke, finn det i havnen i Bergen og velg det. Som De ser, har reisen satt sine spor: skipets tilstand er ikke lenger 100 %. Vi maa derfor reparere det.

column2: \\f1_Click the shipyard in the harbour of the town to enter it. At the shipyard, you can repair your ships, place orders for new ships,increase the ship's armourments or change the name of a ship. We are only interested in the button "repair ship". Please click on it.
column3: \\f1_Klikk paa verftet i byens havn for aa gaa inn. Paa verftet kan De reparere skipene Deres, bestille nye skip, oeke skipenes bevaepning eller endre navnet paa et skip. Vi er bare interessert i knappen "reparer skipet". Klikk paa den.

column2: \\f1_Using the book, you can switch between all ships at anchor and those in need of repair. Under the book you can see the cost of repair and underneath that, the button to place the order for repairs. Click this button and then leave the shipyard.
column3: \\f1_Med boken bytter De mellom alle skip for anker og dem som skal repareres. Under boken ser De reparasjonskostnadene og under dem knappen for aa bestille reparasjonen. Klikk paa denne knappen, og forlat deretter verftet.

column2: \\f1_When you have selected the ship, the selection window will show you how long the estimated repair will take. Of course, this depends on the current ship's status. Now wait until the repair is completed. You can also use the fast-forward button for that.
column3: \\f1_Naar De har valgt skipet, viser utvalgsvinduet hvor lang tid reparasjonen forventes aa ta. Det avhenger naturligvis av skipets naavaerende tilstand. Vent naa til reparasjonen er ferdig. De kan ogsaa bruke knappen spol frem til det.

column2: \\f1_Perhaps you are wondering where to hire crew members for your ship. This takes place in the taverns. Search the centre of Bergen for a tavern. A tip: they have wine barrels on their walls and they are near the shipyard. Do a left click on the tavern.
column3: \\f1_Kanskje lurer De paa hvor man ansetter mannskap til skipet. Det skjer i vertshusene. Finn et vertshus i sentrum av Bergen. Et tips: De har vintoenner paa veggene og ligger like ved verftet. Venstreklikk paa vertshuset.

column2: \\f1_There are certain people in the tavern with whom you can talk. They are not always there, but sailors looking for work are almost always there. Click the sailor's button.
column3: \\f1_I vertshuset er det visse personer som De kan snakke med. De er ikke alltid der, men sjoefolk som soeker arbeid, er der nesten alltid. Klikk paa sjoemannsknappen.

column2: \\f1_As a practice exercise, take on 5 sailors by transferring sailors from the tavern to ship, and clicking the button, "hire sailors".
column3: \\f1_Som oevelse skal De ansette 5 sjoefolk ved aa overfoere sjoefolk fra vertshuset til skipet og klikke paa knappen "ansett sjoefolk".

column2: \\f1_In a similar way, you can employ captains - in so far as they are present. Remember that each ship can only have one captain, and consider that unemployed captains are very much sought after, and are rare in any case.
column3: \\f1_Paa lignende maate kan De ansette kapteiner, saa fremt det finnes noen. Husk at hvert skip bare kan ha én kaptein, og at arbeidsloese kapteiner er svaert ettertraktede og for oevrig sjeldne.

column2: \\f1_There are other people in the tavern are e.g, the informer, the pirate captain and the weapons dealer. Also you can meet travellers and other interesting people who have been in contact with you by letter.
column3: \\f1_I vertshuset er det andre personer, for eksempel angiveren, piratkapteinen og vaapenhandleren. De kan ogsaa moete reisende og andre interessante mennesker som har kontaktet Dem per brev.

column2: \\f1_Now let us look at the construction of a new ship. Go back to Lubeck as it is advantageous to place an order for a new ship in the shipyard of your hometown. Change over the sea map and then click on Lubeck to enter the town. Then select the shipyard.
column3: \\f1_La oss naa se paa bygging av et nytt skip. Gaa tilbake til Luebeck, for det er en fordel aa bestille et nytt skip paa verftet i hjembyen. Bytt til sjoekartet, og klikk deretter paa Luebeck for aa gaa inn i byen. Velg deretter verftet.

column2: \\f1_Select the "Building contract" button in the shipyard. Now use the book to choose a ship. In the beginning of a new game, there are three ships to choose from. If the shipyard gets orders on a regular basis, its quality improves and it can offer better ships. Select a ship and follow the instructions for construction.
column3: \\f1_Velg knappen "Byggebestilling" paa verftet. Bruk naa boken til aa velge et skip. I begynnelsen av et nytt spill er det tre skip aa velge mellom. Hvis verftet faar ordrer jevnlig, forbedres kvaliteten, og det kan tilby bedre skip. Velg et skip, og foelg anvisningene for byggingen.

column2: \\f1_Below the book to the right, you can find the construction time and building costs, and underneath the raw material requirements. Building a new ship requires a lot of raw materials. You have to have them either in stock at your trading office or you have to buy them directly from the town, if available. The estimated construction time is given in days.
column3: \\f1_Under boken til hoeyre finner De byggetid og byggekostnader og under dem de noedvendige raastoffene. Aa bygge et nytt skip krever mange raastoffer. De maa enten ha dem paa lager paa handelskontoret Deres eller kjoepe dem direkte i byen hvis de er aa faa. Den antatte byggetiden angis i dager.

column2: \\f1_In this tutorial, the necessary raw materials are in stock at your trading office, so you do not have to buy them elsewhere. Now confirm the construction of a ship. However, because building a new ship takes a very long time, we will not wait for its completion in this tutorial.
column3: \\f1_I denne oevelsen er de noedvendige raastoffene paa lager paa handelskontoret Deres, saa De trenger ikke kjoepe dem andre steder. Bekreft naa byggingen av et skip. Siden det tar svaert lang tid aa bygge et nytt skip, venter vi imidlertid ikke paa at det blir ferdig i denne oevelsen.

column2: \\f1_Always think very carefully before you place an order to build a new ship; the procurement and maintenance costs are very high. Also bear in mind, that only Snaikka and Crayer can sail to the river towns of: Cologne, Torun and Novgorod. The bigger class of ships cannot navigate the rivers.
column3: \\f1_Tenk alltid grundig over det foer De bestiller et nytt skip; anskaffelses- og vedlikeholdskostnadene er svaert hoeye. Husk ogsaa at bare Snaikka og Crayer kan seile til elvebyene Cologne, Torun og Novgorod. De stoerre skipsklassene kan ikke seile paa elvene.

column2: \\f1_Here the chapter on ships ends. You can have a look around the tavern and dock if you like, before pressing the "continue" button to start the next tutorial.
column3: \\f1_Her slutter kapitlet om skip. De kan gjerne se Dem omkring i vertshuset og paa kaien foer De trykker paa knappen "fortsett" for aa starte neste oevelse.

column2: \\f1_Welcome to chapter three of the tutorial, the most important part of the introductory course for would be maritime traders. It is about trading and everything connected to it, practical tips and valuable background information.
column3: \\f1_Velkommen til oevelsens tredje kapittel, den viktigste delen av innfoeringskurset for kommende sjoehandlere. Det handler om handel og alt som hoerer til: praktiske tips og verdifull bakgrunnskunnskap.

column2: \\f1_We are going to look at purchasing, sales and the transportation of goods. Besides that, I will tell you how prices are created, how to recognise a good price, what requirement the citizens have and where best to buy or sell particular goods.
column3: \\f1_Vi gaar gjennom kjoep, salg og transport av varer. Dessuten forteller jeg hvordan priser oppstaar, hvordan man kjenner igjen en god pris, hvilke behov borgerne har, og hvor man best kjoeper eller selger bestemte varer.

column2: \\f1_But first of all, a few fundamental words about trading.\nCommerce is based on the fact that the towns produce different kinds of goods. On the other hand, however, the citizens and production facilities in the towns have a requirement for all goods. Therefore, each town has to import certain goods in order to flourish.
column3: \\f1_Men foerst noen grunnleggende ord om handel.\nHandel bygger paa at byene produserer ulike typer varer. Paa den andre siden trenger borgerne og produksjonsanleggene i byene alle varer. Derfor maa hver by importere visse varer for aa blomstre.

column2: \\f1_It is you as a trader who supplies the towns with the required goods. Your competitors do the same throughout the Hanse area. You achieve three things in supplying a town:
column3: \\f1_Det er Dem som kjoepmann som forsyner byene med de noedvendige varene. Konkurrentene Deres gjoer det samme i hele Hansaomraadet. Naar De forsyner en by, oppnaar De tre ting:

column2: \\f1_Firstly, citizens and facilities receive the goods and raw materials they require. This leads to higher satisfaction among the citizens, jobs are secure and new jobs can be created. Besides that, a good supply of goods and availability of work lure new citizens to the town.
column3: \\f1_For det foerste faar borgere og anlegg de varene og raastoffene de trenger. Det foerer til stoerre tilfredshet blant borgerne, arbeidsplasser sikres, og nye kan skapes. Dessuten lokker god forsyning og tilgang til arbeid nye borgere til byen.

column2: \\f1_Secondly, the citizens notice when you make an effort to supply your town. Every item sold increases the respect in which you are held.
column3: \\f1_For det andre legger borgerne merke til naar De gjoer en innsats for aa forsyne byen Deres. Hver solgte vare oeker den aktelsen De nyter.

column2: \\f1_Indeed, it must be your objective to attain the rank of a Patrician, and perhaps even to become Lord Mayor. If you succeed you can become famous beyond the borders of your hometown, you could even be elected as Alderman, the chairman of the Hanse.
column3: \\f1_Maalet Deres skal nemlig vaere aa naa rang som patrisier og kanskje til og med bli borgermester. Hvis det lykkes, kan De bli beroemt langt utover hjembyens grenser, og De kan til og med bli valgt til oldermann, Hansaens formann.

column2: \\f1_Thirdly, by trading with the right goods you could make really large profits. You could buy goods cheaply in one town where there is surplus to demand, and sell them at a higher price in another town where the demand is higher.
column3: \\f1_For det tredje kan De tjene veldig store penger ved aa handle med de riktige varene. De kan kjoepe varer billig i en by der det er overskudd, og selge dem dyrere i en annen by der etterspoerselen er stoerre.

column2: \\f1_You can use the profits to expand your business, for example, by building new ships or producing goods yourself.\nHowever, lets get back to the more practical side of things.
column3: \\f1_Overskuddet kan De bruke til aa utvide virksomheten, for eksempel ved aa bygge nye skip eller produsere varer selv.\nMen la oss vende tilbake til den mer praktiske siden av saken.

column2: \\f1_We are back in Lubeck. "Viking" is at anchor in the harbour and you should now select it. There are a number of dock cranes on the quay. Left click on any crane you like to open the trading window.
column3: \\f1_Naa er vi tilbake i Luebeck. "Viking" ligger for anker i havnen, og De skal naa velge det. Paa kaien er det en rekke havnekraner. Venstreklikk paa en vilkaarlig kran for aa aapne handelsvinduet.

column2: \\f1_Dock cranes such as these are in every town. Using the trading window you can trade between town and ship, between town and trading office, as well as between ship and trading office. You can choose the direction of trade by using the buttons in the selection window.
column3: \\f1_Slike havnekraner finnes i hver by. Med handelsvinduet kan De handle mellom by og skip, mellom by og handelskontor og mellom skip og handelskontor. Handelsretningen velger De med knappene i utvalgsvinduet.

column2: \\f1_The menu will only appear if you have a trading office in the town, and a ship has been selected, only then you do have a choice of trading possibilities.
column3: \\f1_Menyen vises bare hvis De har et handelskontor i byen og et skip er valgt; foerst da kan De velge mellom flere handelsmuligheter.

column2: \\f1_Now choose trading between town and ship. On the left, you see the goods that the town has available, and on the right, the goods which are on the ship. As we have just started, there aren't any.
column3: \\f1_Velg naa handel mellom by og skip. Til venstre ser De varene byen har til raadighet, og til hoeyre de som er paa skipet. Siden vi akkurat har begynt, er det ingen.

column2: \\f1_The buy and sell buttons are between town and ship. There is already a price on each button. Buy means, you buy. Sell means, you sell.
column3: \\f1_Kjoeps- og salgsknappene er mellom by og skip. Paa hver knapp staar det allerede en pris. Kjoep betyr at De kjoeper. Selg betyr at De selger.

column2: \\f1_As you can see, the town pays less for a product than the purchase price you had to pay. This is, so to speak, the profit margin of the town. If you buy a product and resell it immediately, you make a loss. You have to sell the product where it is expensive.
column3: \\f1_Som De ser, betaler byen mindre for en vare enn innkjoepsprisen De maatte betale. Det er saa aa si byens fortjenestemargin. Hvis De kjoeper en vare og straks selger den videre, taper De penger. De maa selge varen der den er dyr.

column2: \\f1_Now buy as much fish as your ship can carry. In order to do this, click on the relevant "buy" button several times. Your ship has a capacity for 15 loads of fish.
column3: \\f1_Kjoep naa saa mye fisk som skipet Deres kan baere. Klikk til det flere ganger paa den tilsvarende "kjoep"-knappen. Skipet Deres har plass til 15 laster fisk.

column2: \\f1_Have you noticed how the price of the goods has increased during purchasing? This is because during your purchase the supply in the city has decreased. Note: The smaller the supply, the higher the price. The price falls correspondingly on selling the goods.
column3: \\f1_Har De lagt merke til at varens pris steg under kjoepet? Det skyldes at tilbudet i byen falt mens De kjoepte. Merk: Jo mindre tilbud, desto hoeyere pris. Prisen faller tilsvarende naar De selger varen.

column2: \\f1_However, the price depends, not only on the supply but also on the demand of citizens and business in the town, as they have to live from the goods that are available in the town. Note: the greater the demand, the higher the price.
column3: \\f1_Prisen avhenger imidlertid ikke bare av tilbudet, men ogsaa av etterspoerselen fra byens borgere og virksomheter, siden de maa leve av varene som finnes i byen. Merk: Jo stoerre etterspoersel, desto hoeyere pris.

column2: \\f1_There is a figure next to the fish you have just bought. This is the average price that you have paid per product unit. You now have to find a town which will pay you more than this price. Only then can you make a profit.
column3: \\f1_Ved siden av fisken De nettopp har kjoept, staar det et tall. Det er gjennomsnittsprisen De har betalt per vareenhet. Naa maa De finne en by som betaler mer enn denne prisen. Foerst da tjener De penger.

column2: \\f1_Incidentally, not all goods are measured in loads. Rare goods are measured in barrels; one load takes up the space of 10 barrels. Next to the ship's name you can see that the 15 loads of fish take up the whole cargo space, which is 150 barrels.
column3: \\f1_For oevrig maales ikke alle varer i laster. Sjeldne varer maales i toenner; én last tar like stor plass som 10 toenner. Ved siden av skipets navn kan De se at de 15 lastene fisk fyller hele lasten, som er 150 toenner.

column2: \\f1_As fish is produced in Lubeck, a large amount at a reasonable price is available. Now let's have a look at what other kinds of goods are produced in Lubeck. Now close the trading window with a right mouse click.
column3: \\f1_Siden fisk produseres i Luebeck, er det en stor mengde til en rimelig pris. La oss naa se hvilke andre typer varer som produseres i Luebeck. Lukk naa handelsvinduet med et hoeyreklikk.

column2: \\f1_There is a building standing on columns not far from the harbour. The indoor market is behind the columns. Click this building, it hides a lot of very interesting information.
column3: \\f1_Ikke langt fra havnen staar en bygning paa soeyler. Torvhallen ligger bak soeylene. Klikk paa denne bygningen; den skjuler mye svaert interessant informasjon.

column2: \\f1_Here you can also see what other goods are produced in the town. Click the "production" button. As traders have not yet opened a business in this town, only the production of the town's own facilities will be on display.
column3: \\f1_Her kan De ogsaa se hvilke andre varer som produseres i byen. Klikk paa knappen "produksjon". Siden det ennaa ikke er noen handlende som har aapnet en forretning i denne byen, vises bare produksjonen paa byens egne anlegg.

column2: \\f1_With the "consumption" button you can have the display show you which goods and how much the citizens and businesses consume each week in the town. With these information you can estimate how long the goods will be available.
column3: \\f1_Med knappen "forbruk" kan De faa vist hvilke varer og hvor mye borgerne og virksomhetene i byen forbruker hver uke. Med disse opplysningene kan De vurdere hvor lenge varene rekker.

column2: \\f1_Now let's travel to a town that does not produce fish. London is such a town. Close the market hall, select your ship and indicate London as its destination. With a little help from the fast-forward option, you'll be there in no time.
column3: \\f1_La oss naa reise til en by som ikke produserer fisk. London er en slik by. Lukk torvhallen, velg skipet Deres, og angi London som maal. Med litt hjelp fra spol frem er De der paa et oeyeblikk.

column2: \\f1_Now go to the sea map and click on London to enter the town. Click the dock crane, but remember your ship has to be selected. Sell as much fish as you can until the price people pay you, drops below the average price that you yourself paid.
column3: \\f1_Gaa naa til sjoekartet, og klikk paa London for aa gaa inn i byen. Klikk paa havnekranen, men husk at skipet Deres maa vaere valgt. Selg saa mye fisk De kan, til prisen De faar, faller under gjennomsnittsprisen De selv betalte.

column2: \\f1_If you did not manage to sell all your goods, you can try some other towns. But before you leave, you should try and buy some goods at a reasonable price. However, how does one recognise if an item is on offer at a good price?
column3: \\f1_Hvis det ikke lyktes Dem aa selge alle varene Deres, kan De proeve noen andre byer. Men foer De reiser, boer De proeve aa kjoepe noen varer til en rimelig pris. Hvordan kjenner man imidlertid igjen om en vare tilbys til en god pris?

column2: \\f1_Initially, you should have a look in the market hall to see how high the consumption and stock of particular goods is. The longer a product lasts, the lower the price will be.
column3: \\f1_Foerst boer De se i torvhallen for aa se hvor hoeyt forbruket og lagerbeholdningen er for bestemte varer. Jo lenger en vare rekker, desto lavere blir prisen.

column2: \\f1_There is also some information in the trading window; observe the difference between purchase and selling price. The bigger the difference, the bigger is the demand of the town.
column3: \\f1_Ogsaa i handelsvinduet finnes det opplysninger; legg merke til forskjellen mellom kjoeps- og salgspris. Jo stoerre forskjell, desto stoerre er byens etterspoersel.

column2: \\f1_A difference in price of about 10% is acceptable, however, you should never buy goods that are nearly twice as expensive to buy as to sell. Such a product is in short supply in the town; you would therefore have difficulty in selling it at a profit.
column3: \\f1_En prisforskjell paa rundt 10 % er akseptabel; De boer imidlertid aldri kjoepe varer som er nesten dobbelt saa dyre aa kjoepe som aa selge. Det er mangel paa en slik vare i byen; De ville derfor faa vanskelig for aa selge den med fortjeneste.

column2: \\f1_Now look at the buttons below in the trading window. Here you can indicate the number of items which you wish to trade. Whether you buy 5 products at once, or make 5 single purchases of one product really doesn't matter as the total price is same in either case.
column3: \\f1_Se naa paa knappene nederst i handelsvinduet. Her angir De hvor mange enheter De vil handle. Om De kjoeper 5 varer paa én gang eller gjoer 5 enkeltkjoep av én vare, er egentlig likegyldig, siden totalprisen er den samme i begge tilfeller.

column2: \\f1_Itemisation merely serves to help you to trading in large quantities. The "max" button takes into consideration how much cargo space is still available for goods you are going to purchase. On selling it considers, how many goods on the ship are available. In that way you can sell everything in one go.
column3: \\f1_Oppdelingen i mengder finnes bare for aa hjelpe Dem med aa handle store mengder. Knappen "maks" tar hensyn til hvor mye lasterom som fortsatt er tilgjengelig for varene De skal kjoepe. Ved salg tar den hensyn til hvor mange varer som er paa skipet. Paa den maaten kan De selge alt paa én gang.

column2: \\f1_The basic principles of trading have now been explained. The best way of learning is for you to start on your own.
column3: \\f1_Handelens grunnprinsipper er naa forklart. Den beste maaten aa laere paa er aa sette i gang paa egen haand.

column2: \\f1_Before ending this chapter, I would like to give you some information on the structure of the population in a town. You have already learnt that there are poor, wealthy and rich people in a town. Each group has its own particular needs.
column3: \\f1_Foer vi avslutter dette kapitlet, vil jeg gi Dem noen opplysninger om befolkningsstrukturen i en by. De har allerede laert at det i en by finnes fattige, bemidlede og rike mennesker. Hver gruppe har sine egne behov.

column2: \\f1_While poor people need basic foodstuffs such as wheat, fish and beer, the rich have more expensive needs such as meat, wine and cloth at the top of their list. The wealthy are somewhere between the rich and the poor.
column3: \\f1_Mens de fattige trenger basale naeringsmidler som hvete, fisk og oel, har de rike dyrere behov med kjoett, vin og klede oeverst paa listen. De bemidlede staar et sted mellom de rike og de fattige.

column2: \\f1_An increase in your social or economic standing depends on which group you primarily provide with goods.\nYour popularity does not only increase with the selling of goods. Everything you do for the benefit of the Hanse and its citizens, takes you further to the top.
column3: \\f1_Deres sosiale og oekonomiske fremgang avhenger av hvilken gruppe De primaert forsyner med varer.\nPopulariteten Deres vokser ikke bare ved salg av varer. Alt De gjoer til gavn for Hansaen og dens borgere, bringer Dem hoeyere opp.

column2: \\f1_Click the "continue" button to end this chapter.
column3: \\f1_Klikk paa knappen "fortsett" for aa avslutte dette kapitlet.

column2: \\f1_In the fourth chapter of this tutorial, we will deal with the building up of towns and their growth. You will learn what buildings are important for the creation of towns, and what buildings you can build yourself to speed up the building of a town.
column3: \\f1_I oevelsens fjerde kapittel behandler vi oppbyggingen av byer og veksten deres. De laerer hvilke bygninger som er viktige for at byer kan oppstaa, og hvilke bygninger De selv kan bygge for aa fremskynde en bys vekst.

column2: \\f1_Each town consist of action houses, dwellings and production facilities. Action houses are buildings where you can do certain things. You already know the dock and the tavern. Other buildings are the church and the municipal building. A Hanse town like Lubeck has 12 action buildings.
column3: \\f1_Hver by bestaar av funksjonsbygninger, boliger og produksjonsanlegg. Funksjonsbygninger er bygninger der man kan gjoere bestemte ting. Havnen og vertshuset kjenner De allerede. Andre bygninger er kirken og raadhuset. En hansaby som Luebeck har 12 funksjonsbygninger.

column2: \\f1_In the first instance, your most important building is your trading office. In Lubeck, it is placed on the left near the seafront. In your hometown, the trading office is also  your living quarters, office and warehouse. In other towns it presents a branch of your trading company.
column3: \\f1_Foerst og fremst er Deres viktigste bygning handelskontoret Deres. I Luebeck ligger det til venstre naer havnefronten. I hjembyen Deres er handelskontoret ogsaa bolig, kontor og lager. I andre byer utgjoer det en filial av handelsselskapet Deres.

column2: \\f1_However, within the framework of the tutorial, we won't be speaking about every single building in detail.\nBut note that you can click on any building in Patrician 3, and that the action houses are always in the harbour area or near the market square.
column3: \\f1_Innenfor rammen av oevelsen vil vi imidlertid ikke snakke om hver enkelt bygning i detalj.\nMen merk at De kan klikke paa enhver bygning i Patrician 3, og at funksjonsbygningene alltid ligger i havneomraadet eller naer torget.

column2: \\f1_Apart from the auction houses, there are also dwellings and production facilities. The production facilities produce raw materials and goods, the workers and tradesmen as well as their families live in the dwellings.
column3: \\f1_I tillegg til funksjonsbygningene finnes det ogsaa boliger og produksjonsanlegg. Produksjonsanleggene fremstiller raastoffer og varer; arbeiderne og haandverkerne og familiene deres bor i boligene.

column2: \\f1_You can build production facilities and houses wherever you have built a trading office.
column3: \\f1_De kan bygge produksjonsanlegg og hus overalt der De har bygget et handelskontor.

column2: \\f1_Another advantage of a trading office is that you can enter the town even if you do not have a ship at anchor in the harbour.\nAs already mentioned, such towns are marked in blue on the sea map.
column3: \\f1_En annen fordel med et handelskontor er at De kan gaa inn i byen selv om De ikke har et skip for anker i havnen.\nSom allerede nevnt er slike byer markert med blaatt paa sjoekartet.

column2: \\f1_Now let's look at the production facilities in Lubeck. Since each town has other geographical prerequisites and also historically the skills of the population varied in the different towns, you can only build certain facilities in each town.
column3: \\f1_La oss naa se paa produksjonsanleggene i Luebeck. Siden hver by har ulike geografiske forutsetninger, og befolkningens ferdigheter ogsaa historisk varierte fra by til by, kan De bare bygge bestemte anlegg i hver by.

column2: \\f1_Now open the building menu. It is the fourth button on the button bar. The building menu contains the trading office building, municipal buildings, raw material and production facilities, as well as fortification measures. Click once on each category to see what is hidden behind it.
column3: \\f1_Aapne naa byggemenyen. Det er den fjerde knappen paa knapperekken. Byggemenyen inneholder bygging av handelskontor, kommunale bygninger, raastoff- og produksjonsanlegg og befestningstiltak. Klikk én gang paa hver kategori for aa se hva som skjuler seg bak den.

column2: \\f1_You cannot select fortification because you only have access to fortification after you have become Lord Mayor of a town.\nNow select "finishing companies" and then "workshop".
column3: \\f1_Befestning kan De ikke velge, fordi De foerst faar tilgang til den naar De er blitt borgermester i en by.\nVelg naa "foredlingsvirksomheter" og deretter "verksted".

column2: \\f1_In the selection window you will now see the building costs, construction time and the  building materials required. These materials will be taken from your trading office if they are available there. If this is not the case, then they will be bought directly from the town.The purchase prices applicable are displayed.
column3: \\f1_I utvalgsvinduet ser De naa byggekostnader, byggetid og de noedvendige byggematerialene. Disse materialene tas fra handelskontoret Deres hvis de finnes der. Er det ikke tilfellet, kjoepes de direkte i byen. De gjeldende innkjoepsprisene vises.

column2: \\f1_It may occur that a particular building material is neither available in the town nor present in your trading office. In this case, you will have to buy the required raw material from another town before you can construct a building.
column3: \\f1_Det kan hende at et bestemt byggemateriale verken finnes i byen eller i handelskontoret Deres. I saa fall maa De kjoepe det noedvendige raastoffet i en annen by foer De kan bygge en bygning.

column2: \\f1_ For the workshop, however, this is not the case. Since enough raw materials are available, you will see all the building plots that the town's planning office has allocated to you marked on the town view of the mini map.
column3: \\f1_For verkstedets del er det imidlertid ikke tilfellet. Siden det er raastoffer nok, ser De paa minikartets byvisning alle byggetomtene som byens byplankontor har tildelt Dem, markert.

column2: \\f1_Now move the mouse over one of these building plots. You can also use the arrows on the keyboard to get a visible plot. If you move the mouse pointer over a building plot, the workshop lights up. Please left click.
column3: \\f1_Flytt naa musen over en av disse byggetomtene. De kan ogsaa bruke piltastene paa tastaturet for aa faa en tomt i sikte. Hvis De flytter musepekeren over en byggetomt, lyser verkstedet opp. Venstreklikk.

column2: \\f1_A building site appears and raw materials as well as money are deducted. Now choose "back" in the selection window to exit building. If you look at the building site for a while, you will see how the building slowly takes shape.
column3: \\f1_En byggeplass dukker opp, og raastoffer og penger trekkes fra. Velg naa "tilbake" i utvalgsvinduet for aa forlate byggingen. Hvis De ser paa byggeplassen en stund, kan De se hvordan bygningen langsomt tar form.

column2: \\f1_Now activate fast-forward for as long as it takes to complete the workshop. Now click the finished building. At first, you will be shown how many workshops you own in Lubeck. Next to the workers symbol, you can see how many workers are currently available and the maximum number required.
column3: \\f1_Aktiver naa spol frem saa lenge det tar aa ferdigstille verkstedet. Klikk deretter paa den ferdige bygningen. Foerst vises det hvor mange verksteder De eier i Luebeck. Ved siden av arbeidersymbolet kan De se hvor mange arbeidere som for oeyeblikket er tilgjengelige, og det maksimale antallet som kreves.

column2: \\f1_All facilities of the same kind are combined at this stage. Here, you can also decide the capacity of the facilities.
column3: \\f1_Alle anlegg av samme slag er paa dette trinnet slaatt sammen. Her kan De ogsaa bestemme kapasiteten til anleggene.

column2: \\f1_Below, you will see what kind of raw materials the facility needs and what goods it produces. Iron ore and wood is needed in the case of the workshop, where iron-goods are produced. In order for this facility to start producing, you will have to have the raw materials available in your trading office, which is currently the case.
column3: \\f1_Under ser De hvilke raastoffer anlegget trenger, og hvilke varer det fremstiller. Til verkstedet, der jernvarer fremstilles, kreves jernmalm og tre. For at dette anlegget skal kunne begynne aa produsere, maa raastoffene vaere tilgjengelige i handelskontoret Deres, noe de akkurat naa er.

column2: \\f1_Now look at the total cost: it is the weekly overheads of all companies of this kind. It is made up of basic tax, maintenance and wages costs. To keep production costs low, that is, the production price per goods, you must try to keep the facility running at full capacity.
column3: \\f1_Se naa paa de samlede kostnadene: Det er de ukentlige faste utgiftene for alle virksomheter av denne typen. De bestaar av grunnskatt, vedlikehold og loennskostnader. For aa holde produksjonskostnadene nede, det vil si produksjonsprisen per vare, maa De proeve aa holde anlegget i gang med full kapasitet.

column2: \\f1_Note that the production cost of a given item is not the same in every town. In some towns goods can be produced on especially favourable terms, in others less so, and in others no goods at all can be produced. Production costs are correspondingly higher in towns with low production. Please have a look at the enclosed map.
column3: \\f1_Merk at produksjonskostnaden for en gitt vare ikke er den samme i alle byer. I noen byer kan varer produseres paa saerlig gunstige vilkaar, i andre mindre og i andre slett ikke. Produksjonskostnadene er tilsvarende hoeyere i byer med lav produksjon. Se gjerne paa det vedlagte kartet.

column2: \\f1_Incidentally, you can get information about facilities that you did not build yourself. The mini map show buildings belonging to you and those belonging to someone else. Your buildings are coloured blue, those of others traders are white, and those of the town are grey.
column3: \\f1_For oevrig kan De ogsaa faa opplysninger om anlegg som De ikke selv har bygget. Minikartet viser bygninger som tilhoerer Dem, og bygninger som tilhoerer andre. Deres bygninger er blaa, andre handlendes er hvite, og byens er graa.

column2: \\f1_You can also click the house symbol in the title bar. This will show the facilities and houses which were built by others. This is very useful because it shows the presence of your competitors in the town and your own presence in comparison.
column3: \\f1_De kan ogsaa klikke paa husymbolet i tittellinjen. Da vises anleggene og husene som andre har bygget. Det er svaert nyttig, fordi det viser konkurrentenes tilstedevaerelse i byen og Deres egen til sammenligning.

column2: \\f1_Now let us build a living house. For this you need to know that per worker in the town, four citizens on average have to be accommodated in a house as every worker also has a family. If there is not enough accommodation available, the number of workers cannot increase.
column3: \\f1_La oss naa bygge et bolighus. Til det maa De vite at for hver arbeider i byen maa det i gjennomsnitt innlosjeres fire borgere i et hus, fordi hver arbeider ogsaa har en familie. Hvis det ikke er nok boliger, kan antall arbeidere ikke oeke.

column2: \\f1_You can find out how high the percentage of occupancy is of the present housing by clicking on a house.\nEach living house consists of three stages, of which you can only build the first. The later stages are reached as more and more people move into it.
column3: \\f1_Ved aa klikke paa et hus kan De finne ut hvor hoey belegget er i de naavaerende boligene.\nHvert bolighus bestaar av tre trinn, hvorav De bare kan bygge det foerste. De senere trinnene naas etter hvert som flere og flere mennesker flytter inn.

column2: \\f1_If all living houses have reached the third stage, it is a sign that accommodation is becoming short in the town.\nNow build a half-timbered house for the poor people in town.
column3: \\f1_Hvis alle bolighus har naadd det tredje trinnet, er det et tegn paa at boligene begynner aa bli knappe i byen.\nBygg naa et bindingsverkshus for byens fattige.

column2: \\f1_Now proceed with this building as you did with the workshop. After it is completed, you can watch the people moving in. In order for it to become full, there has to be work available in the town. Then beggars can become workers and advance to the poor citizens class.
column3: \\f1_Gaa naa frem med denne bygningen som med verkstedet. Naar den er ferdig, kan De se hvordan folk flytter inn. For at den skal kunne bli full, maa det vaere arbeid i byen. Da kan tiggere bli arbeidere og rykke opp i klassen av fattige borgere.

column2: \\f1_To do so however, the quality of life of the poor has to have a certain standard. If the poor citizens of the town are dissatisfied, because, for example, there are not enough goods available, beggars will not come into town and consequently you cannot employ any new workers.
column3: \\f1_Til det kreves imidlertid at de fattiges livskvalitet har et visst nivaa. Hvis byens fattige borgere er misfornoeyde, for eksempel fordi det ikke er nok varer, kommer ikke tiggerne til byen, og De kan foelgelig ikke ansette nye arbeidere.

column2: \\f1_The population of a town consists of: beggars, poor, wealthy and rich people. Each group has its own requirements and consumes certain goods. Wheat, for example, is very important to the poor, whereas wine and meat is more important to the rich.
column3: \\f1_En bys befolkning bestaar av: tiggere, fattige, bemidlede og rike. Hver gruppe har sine egne behov og forbruker bestemte varer. Hvete er for eksempel svaert viktig for de fattige, mens vin og kjoett er viktigere for de rike.

column2: \\f1_Now click once on the population symbol on the title bar. In one window you will see the size of each group on the display. Note, that there are always fewer rich than wealthy, and fewer wealthy than poor people in a town.
column3: \\f1_Klikk naa én gang paa befolkningssymbolet i tittellinjen. I et vindu ser De stoerrelsen paa hver gruppe. Merk at det i en by alltid er faerre rike enn bemidlede og faerre bemidlede enn fattige.

column2: \\f1_In this window, you can also see how satisfied a particular group is. A dissatisfied or angry group of citizens cannot grow; on the contrary, it will shrink. To satisfy the citizens of a town, at the least, the most important goods must be available.
column3: \\f1_I dette vinduet kan De ogsaa se hvor tilfreds en bestemt gruppe er. En misfornoeyd eller sint gruppe borgere kan ikke vokse; tvert imot krymper den. For aa tilfredsstille en bys borgere maa i det minste de viktigste varene vaere tilgjengelige.

column2: \\f1_Incidentally, once a group has become mutinous, it'll take some time to get the mood back to normal again, therefore, you have to have patience. On the arrow to the right of "Satisfaction" you can recognise whether the mood of a group is improving or getting worse.
column3: \\f1_For oevrig tar det tid aa faa stemningen tilbake til det normale naar en gruppe foerst har gjort mytteri; De maa altsaa ha taalmodighet. Paa pilen til hoeyre for "Tilfredshet" kan De se om en gruppes stemning blir bedre eller daarligere.

column2: \\f1_But luckily, you are not the only trader who transports and supplies goods. However, you can have great influence on whether a town really grows to become one of importance.
column3: \\f1_Men heldigvis er De ikke den eneste handlende som transporterer og leverer varer. De kan imidlertid ha stor innflytelse paa om en by virkelig vokser til en betydelig by.

column2: \\f1_Apart from the availability of goods however, there are other factors that influence satisfaction. Wells, hospitals, good roads and the defence situation can all to some degree improve the quality of life in the town.
column3: \\f1_I tillegg til tilgangen til varer er det andre faktorer som paavirker tilfredsheten. Broenner, sykehus, gode veier og forsvarssituasjonen kan alle i en viss utstrekning forbedre livskvaliteten i byen.

column2: \\f1_Now click the "continue" button to end this chapter.
column3: \\f1_Klikk naa paa knappen "fortsett" for aa avslutte dette kapitlet.

column2: \\f1_Welcome to the tutorial on sea battles.\nDuring your long journeys through the sea area of the Hanse, you can repeatedly be attacked by pirates who, unfortunately, have nothing else in mind than to steal your ship and its cargo.
column3: \\f1_Velkommen til oevelsen om sjoeslag.\nUnder de lange reisene Deres gjennom Hansaens sjoeomraade kan De gang paa gang bli angrepet av pirater, som dessverre ikke har annet i sinne enn aa stjele skipet Deres og lasten.

column2: \\f1_If you meet a pirate on the sea map, you will be informed about it and additionally asked whether you want to handle the sea-battle automatically or manually. If you select manually, you will see this sea-battle view.
column3: \\f1_Hvis De moeter en pirat paa sjoekartet, faar De beskjed om det og blir dessuten spurt om De vil haandtere sjoeslaget automatisk eller manuelt. Velger De manuelt, ser De denne sjoeslagsvisningen.

column2: \\f1_As only three empty ships are involved, you have nothing to fear from your enemy on this occasion. But you can practice how to navigate a ship during a sea battle. First of all, select your ship "Viking" and look at its data.
column3: \\f1_Siden det bare er tre tomme skip involvert, har De ingenting aa frykte fra fienden denne gangen. Men De kan oeve Dem paa aa manoevrere et skip under et sjoeslag. Velg foerst skipet Deres "Viking", og se paa dataene.

column2: \\f1_As you can see the deck is displayed automatically. The ship is a crayer that has twice had additional armour added in the shipyard. As a result of this it has lost cargo space, but at the same time, has increased its armament ability, as you can see from the 8 small catapults.
column3: \\f1_Som De ser, vises dekket automatisk. Skipet er en crayer som to ganger har faatt ekstra panser paa verftet. Dermed har det mistet lasterom, men samtidig oekt bevaepningsevnen, som det ses av de 8 smaa katapultene.

column2: \\f1_By the way, a ship also gains more stability by adding armour.\nNow let us observe the functions and displays of the deck. At first, speed, condition, crew and weapons strength are shown. Next to that is the button "Fire"
column3: \\f1_Et skip blir foroevrig ogsaa mer stabilt med ekstra panser.\nLa oss naa betrakte dekkets funksjoner og visninger. Foerst vises fart, tilstand, mannskap og vaapenstyrke. Ved siden av er knappen "Ild".

column2: \\f1_Your ship automatically shoots in the enemy's direction with "fire". Click on this button now. You will then see how a salvo leaves your ship and lands in the water. Apart from that, you will notice that it takes a while for the ship's weapons to be reloaded.
column3: \\f1_Med "ild" skyter skipet Deres automatisk i fiendens retning. Klikk naa paa denne knappen. De ser da hvordan en salve forlater skipet Deres og lander i vannet. Dessuten vil De oppdage at det tar en stund foer skipets vaapen er ladet igjen.

column2: \\f1_Instead of clicking "fire", you can also press the space bar on the keyboard or the number 0 on the numbers block.\nUsing the "Capture" or "Plunder" button you are giving you ship the signal to board the enemy if possible, trying to capture or plunder the enemy vessel.
column3: \\f1_I stedet for aa klikke paa "ild" kan De ogsaa trykke paa mellomromstasten paa tastaturet eller paa 0 paa det numeriske tastaturet.\nMed knappen "Entre" eller "Plyndring" gir De skipet Deres signal om aa entre fienden hvis det er mulig, og forsoeke aa erobre eller plyndre fiendens skip.

column2: \\f1_Boarding will start as soon as the ships are close to each other and of course, you can only board a ship when your crew is superior in number.\nPlease note, that the ship deck functions are only at your disposal during a sea battle.
column3: \\f1_Entringen begynner saa snart skipene er tett paa hverandre, og De kan naturligvis bare entre et skip naar mannskapet Deres er i overtall.\nMerk at skipets dekksfunksjoner bare staar til Deres raadighet under et sjoeslag.

column2: \\f1_Now let us get your ship moving. First of all, you have to set the sails. You do this by clicking the rope. You can change the height of the sails by using the keys, "page up" and "page down" on the keyboard.
column3: \\f1_La oss naa faa skipet Deres i bevegelse. Foerst maa De sette seil. Det gjoer De ved aa klikke paa tauet. De kan endre seilenes hoeyde med tastene "page up" og "page down" paa tastaturet.

column2: \\f1_You can change the direction of the ship by right clicking on a spot in the water. You can also press the right mouse key, hold it, and move the mouse at the same time. The arrow on the water will then show you which direction the ship is now sailing in.
column3: \\f1_De kan endre skipets retning ved aa hoeyreklikke paa et punkt i vannet. De kan ogsaa holde hoeyre museknapp nede og flytte musen samtidig. Pilen paa vannet viser Dem da i hvilken retning skipet seiler.

column2: \\f1_Have you seen the clouds passing by? They are showing you wind direction and wind force. Always avoid sailing directly against the wind.\nNow set a course towards one of the ships. If the button "Capture" has been activated, please deactivate it.
column3: \\f1_Har De sett skyene drive forbi? De viser Dem vindens retning og styrke. Unngaa alltid aa seile rett mot vinden.\nSett naa kurs mot et av skipene. Hvis knappen "Entre" er aktivert, maa De deaktivere den.

column2: \\f1_As soon as an enemy ship appears at the side of your ship, you should fire a broadside. Now cross backwards and forwards around the ship and try to sink it by firing broadsides at it. Try to take advantage of the momentum on manoeuvring, and avoid sailing against the wind.
column3: \\f1_Saa snart et fiendtlig skip dukker opp ved siden av skipet Deres, boer De avfyre en bredside. Kryss naa frem og tilbake rundt skipet, og proev aa senke det med bredsider. Proev aa utnytte farten ved manoevrering, og unngaa aa seile mot vinden.

column2: \\f1_Now let us attack the enemy in another way. If you have selected your ship, simply right click onto an enemy. Your ship will now automatically attack and sink him. Make sure that "capture" is not activated; otherwise your crew will board the enemy ship.
column3: \\f1_La oss naa angripe fienden paa en annen maate. Hvis De har valgt skipet Deres, trenger De bare aa hoeyreklikke paa en fiende. Skipet Deres angriper og senker ham da automatisk. Soerg for at "entre" ikke er aktivert; ellers entrer mannskapet Deres fiendens skip.

column2: \\f1_This automatic control is very practical when you are in battle with several ships.\nBefore moving on to the third ship, you should practice.As soon as the last ship has been defeated, the sea battle is over and the view changes back to the sea map.
column3: \\f1_Denne automatiske styringen er svaert praktisk naar De kjemper mot flere skip.\nFoer De gaar videre til det tredje skipet, boer De oeve Dem. Saa snart det siste skipet er beseiret, er sjoeslaget over, og visningen skifter tilbake til sjoekartet.

column2: \\f1_We are now going to board the third ship. Activate "capture" and right click on the enemy or approach him manually. The boarding fight will begin as soon as the ships are close enough to each other. As the enemy does not have a crew the situation is very quickly decided.
column3: \\f1_Naa skal vi entre det tredje skipet. Aktiver "entre", og hoeyreklikk paa fienden, eller naerm Dem ham manuelt. Entringskampen begynner saa snart skipene er tett nok paa hverandre. Siden fienden ikke har noe mannskap, avgjoeres situasjonen veldig raskt.

column2: \\f1_After each sea battle, a summary is shown and you return to the sea map.
column3: \\f1_Etter hvert sjoeslag vises en oversikt, og De vender tilbake til sjoekartet.

column2: \\f1_We have now come to the end of the tutorial. Select "End Game" (Quit) in the options menu in order to return to the main menu.
column3: \\f1_Naa er vi kommet til slutten av oevelsen. Velg "Avslutt spillet" i innstillingsmenyen for aa vende tilbake til hovedmenyen.
